content.text: Now I have a comprehensive understanding of the entire codebase. Here is the complete implementation plan: --- # ISAFlow Onboarding Workflow — Implementation Plan ## Architecture Overview The onboarding system consists of six layers: 1. A new SQL migration for `company_documents` and `onboarding_completed` flag 2. A registration API and page 3. An onboarding wizard (7-step, `pages/onboarding/`) 4. A company logo upload API 5. A company documents upload API 6. Middleware, context, and settings page updates --- ## Phase 1 — Database Migration ### File: `scripts/migrations/sql/243_onboarding.sql` (NEW) This migration adds two things: the `company_documents` table and an `onboarding_completed` flag on `users`. ```sql -- 243: Onboarding support — company documents + user onboarding flag -- Track whether a user has completed the onboarding wizard. -- We use a boolean on users rather than a separate table for simplicity. ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_completed BOOLEAN DEFAULT false; -- Statutory documents linked to a company (CIPC cert, tax clearance, B-BBEE, VAT reg) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company_documents ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), company_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, document_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (document_type IN ( 'cipc_certificate', 'tax_clearance', 'bbbee_certificate', 'vat_registration', 'other' )), document_name TEXT NOT NULL, file_data TEXT NOT NULL, -- base64-encoded file content mime_type TEXT NOT NULL, file_size INTEGER NOT NULL, uploaded_by TEXT NOT NULL, -- user id uploaded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true, notes TEXT ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_company_docs_company ON company_documents(company_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_company_docs_type ON company_documents(document_type); ``` Also update `scripts/run-migrations.mjs` to add `'243_onboarding.sql'` to the `migrations` array. --- ## Phase 2 — Registration API ### File: `pages/api/auth/register.ts` (NEW) Pattern: same structure as `login.ts`. Uses `hashPassword` from `@/lib/auth`. No JWT issuance at this point — user must log in after registering. Key logic: - POST only - Validate: `firstName`, `lastName`, `email`, `password`, `confirmPassword` - Call `checkPasswordStrength(password)` — reject if `score < 2` - Check email uniqueness via `SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = $email LIMIT 1` - `hashPassword(password)` then `INSERT INTO users` - Assign `role = 'viewer'`, `permissions = '[]'`, `is_active = true`, `onboarding_completed = false` - Return `apiResponse.created(res, { userId, email })` — do NOT set a cookie here - Error on duplicate email: `apiResponse.error(res, ErrorCode.CONFLICT, 'Email already registered')` Note: the `users` table uses `VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT` so no special UUID handling is needed — the DB handles the ID. --- ## Phase 3 — Registration Page ### File: `pages/register.tsx` (NEW) Pattern: mirrors `login.tsx` exactly — same dark `bg-gray-950` layout, same ISAFlow logo, same card style (`bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded-2xl`), same teal button. Fields: - First name + Last name (side-by-side grid) - Email address - Password (with show/hide toggle, same `Eye`/`EyeOff` pattern) - Confirm password - Password strength indicator (4-bar meter using `checkPasswordStrength` client-side) Password strength meter: a row of 4 divs, colored `bg-red-500` / `bg-yellow-500` / `bg-green-500` / `bg-teal-500` based on `score` from `checkPasswordStrength`. Show the first failing issue as hint text. On submit: `POST /api/auth/register`. On success: `router.push('/login?registered=1')`. On the login page, read `router.query.registered` and show a success banner "Account created! Please sign in." Footer link: "Already have an account? Sign in" → `/login` --- ## Phase 4 — Onboarding Wizard ### Directory: `pages/onboarding/` (NEW) Single entry point: `pages/onboarding/index.tsx` The wizard manages a single `formData` state object across 7 steps. No server calls are made per-step — all data is accumulated in React state and submitted step-by-step or all at once at completion. #### Step Structure ```typescript // Accumulated wizard state shape interface WizardData { // Step 1 — Company details name: string; tradingName: string; registrationNumber: string; vatNumber: string; taxNumber: string; // Step 2 — Address & contact addressLine1: string; addressLine2: string; city: string; province: string; postalCode: string; country: string; phone: string; email: string; website: string; // Step 3 — Logo (base64 data URL from FileReader) logoData: string | null; // Step 4 — Banking bankName: string; bankAccountNumber: string; bankBranchCode: string; bankAccountType: string; // current | savings | transmission | credit // Step 5 — Financial preferences financialYearStart: number; // 1-12 vatPeriod: string; // monthly | bi-monthly defaultCurrency: string; // ZAR default // Step 6 — Documents (array of file objects with type + base64) documents: Array<{ type: 'cipc_certificate' | 'tax_clearance' | 'bbbee_certificate' | 'vat_registration'; name: string; data: string; // base64 mimeType: string; size: number; }>; } ``` #### Step 1 — Company Details Standard form fields. `name` is required. Province dropdown uses SA provinces: `['Eastern Cape', 'Free State', 'Gauteng', 'KwaZulu-Natal', 'Limpopo', 'Mpumalanga', 'North West', 'Northern Cape', 'Western Cape']`. #### Step 2 — Address & Contact Address fields + contact. Country defaults to "South Africa". #### Step 3 — Logo Upload Drag-and-drop zone using the `onDragOver`/`onDrop` event pattern. Also a `` fallback. On file select: use `FileReader.readAsDataURL()` to produce a base64 data URL. Show preview `` in a 150px square. Allow removal. Client-side validation: max 2MB, must be `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, or `image/webp`. #### Step 4 — Banking Details Bank name (text input with datalist suggestions for SA banks: FNB, Standard Bank, Nedbank, ABSA, Capitec, Investec), account number, branch code, account type (select: Current, Savings, Transmission, Credit Card). #### Step 5 — Financial Preferences Financial year start month (select with month names), VAT period (Monthly / Bi-Monthly), default currency (select: ZAR default, USD, EUR, GBP, others). #### Step 6 — Statutory Documents Four document upload slots: - CIPC Registration Certificate (required for registered companies) - SARS Tax Clearance Certificate - B-BBEE Certificate - VAT Registration Certificate Each slot: a bordered upload zone, shows filename + size once uploaded, allow removal. Files read as base64 via `FileReader`. All are optional (can skip). Max 10MB per document. #### Step 7 — Review & Complete Read-only summary of all entered data in collapsible sections. A "Complete Setup" button that: 1. `POST /api/accounting/companies` with all company data including `logoData` 2. After company created, `POST /api/onboarding/documents` for each uploaded document 3. `POST /api/onboarding/complete` to mark onboarding done 4. `router.push('/accounting')` #### Wizard Shell Layout No `AppLayout` wrapper — the onboarding has its own full-page layout with: - ISAFlow logo top-left - Step progress bar (7 dots with connecting line, current step highlighted teal) - Step title + subtitle - Content area - Back / Continue / Skip buttons - "Skip for now" link (only on optional steps 3, 4, 5, 6) --- ## Phase 5 — Onboarding APIs ### File: `pages/api/onboarding/complete.ts` (NEW) POST only, `withAuth` middleware. Marks `onboarding_completed = true` for the authenticated user: ```sql UPDATE users SET onboarding_completed = true WHERE id = $userId ``` Returns `apiResponse.success(res, { completed: true })`. ### File: `pages/api/onboarding/documents.ts` (NEW) POST only, `withAuth` middleware. Accepts JSON body (not multipart — because we're passing base64 strings from the wizard state). Body: `{ companyId, documents: [{ type, name, data, mimeType, size }] }` Iterates over documents and inserts into `company_documents`. Validates `companyId` ownership via `company_users` table. Returns list of created document IDs. Note: This differs from `procurement_documents` which uses file storage. Here we store base64 directly in the DB column `file_data`. This is appropriate for statutory documents (PDFs typically under 5MB each) and avoids the `vfStorage` dependency during onboarding. ### File: `pages/api/accounting/company-logo.ts` (NEW) POST only, `withAuth` middleware, `export const config = { api: { bodyParser: false } }`. Accepts multipart/form-data with fields: `companyId`, `file` (image). Processing: 1. Parse with `formidable` 2. Validate: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp` only, max 5MB 3. Validate magic bytes (JPEG: `FFD8FF`, PNG: `89504E47`, WebP: `52494646...57454250`) 4. Read file buffer, convert to base64: `buffer.toString('base64')` 5. Build data URL: `` `data:${mimeType};base64,${base64}` `` 6. `UPDATE companies SET logo_data = $dataUrl WHERE id = $companyId` 7. Verify user is `owner` or `admin` via `company_users` before updating Returns `{ logoData: dataUrl }`. Note: The wizard bypasses this API and stores logo data directly via the companies POST. This API is for the settings page logo update after onboarding. --- ## Phase 6 — Company Documents API ### File: `pages/api/accounting/company-documents.ts` (NEW) GET + POST + DELETE, `withAuth` middleware. **GET** `?companyId=...` — Returns list of active documents for a company. Verifies user membership. Returns `{ items: [{ id, documentType, documentName, mimeType, fileSize, uploadedAt, notes }] }` — does NOT return `file_data` in the list (to avoid large payloads). **GET** `?id=...&download=1` — Returns single document including `file_data` for download. **POST** — JSON body (base64). Creates `company_documents` record. Validates ownership. **DELETE** `?id=...` — Soft-deletes by setting `is_active = false`. --- ## Phase 7 — Middleware Updates ### File: `middleware.ts` (MODIFY) Three changes: 1. Add `/register` and `/api/auth/register` to `PUBLIC_PATHS` 2. Add `/onboarding` to `PUBLIC_PATHS` (onboarding pages handle their own auth check via `useAuth`) 3. Add logic: authenticated users hitting `/accounting` with no company get redirected to `/onboarding` The third point is the trickiest in Edge middleware because we can't query the DB. The approach: after the onboarding wizard completes, store a flag in a cookie `ff_onboarding_done=1` (non-HttpOnly, accessible client-side for re-reads, but set server-side for reliability). The `complete.ts` API sets this cookie when it marks `onboarding_completed = true`. Middleware then checks: if `token` exists but `ff_onboarding_done` cookie is absent → redirect to `/onboarding`. This avoids a DB call in the edge. ```typescript // In middleware — after token check, before returning next() if (token && !request.cookies.get('ff_onboarding_done')?.value) { if (pathname.startsWith('/accounting')) { return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/onboarding', request.url)); } } ``` The `complete.ts` API sets this cookie: ```typescript res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', serialize('ff_onboarding_done', '1', { httpOnly: false, secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production', sameSite: 'lax', path: '/', maxAge: 365 * 24 * 60 * 60, // 1 year })); ``` Also: the login API should check `onboarding_completed` on the user row and include it in the response. The `AuthContext.login()` can then decide to redirect to `/onboarding` rather than `returnTo`. Alternatively — and this is cleaner — the `complete.ts` cookie approach handles it automatically regardless of how the user logs in. Existing users (those who had accounts before this feature) need the flag set. A one-time migration sets `onboarding_completed = true` for all users who already have a company: ```sql UPDATE users u SET onboarding_completed = true WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company_users cu WHERE cu.user_id = u.id ); ``` Add this to `243_onboarding.sql` and also seed the `ff_onboarding_done` cookie for existing users in the login handler. #### Login Handler Adjustment (`pages/api/auth/login.ts`) After successful login, query whether the user has `onboarding_completed = true`. Include it in the response: ```typescript // After selecting user const rows = await sql` SELECT id, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, role, is_active, permissions, profile_picture, department, onboarding_completed FROM users WHERE email = $email LIMIT 1 `; // ... // After setting the auth cookie, also set the onboarding cookie if already done if (user.onboarding_completed) { const cookies = [authCookie, serialize('ff_onboarding_done', '1', { ... })]; res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', cookies); } // Return onboarding status in response return apiResponse.success(res, { user: { ...authUser, onboardingCompleted: user.onboarding_completed } }); ``` The `AuthContext.login()` function can then check `data.data?.user?.onboardingCompleted` and route accordingly. But the cookie approach in middleware handles the redirect automatically. --- ## Phase 8 — CompanyContext & AuthContext Updates ### File: `src/contexts/CompanyContext.tsx` (MODIFY) Currently at line 137: `if (list.length === 0) { setLoading(false); return; }` — this silently handles the no-company state. We should expose a `hasNoCompany` boolean: ```typescript const hasNoCompany = isAuthenticated && !loading && companies.length === 0; ``` Export this from context and use it in `AppLayout` to show a "Create your first company" prompt instead of the normal layout. This is a secondary UI guard in addition to the middleware redirect. ### File: `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` (MODIFY — minor) Add `onboardingCompleted: boolean` to `AuthUser`. Map it from the login/me API response. This lets the onboarding page know the current state without a separate API call. --- ## Phase 9 — Landing Page Updates ### File: `pages/index.tsx` (MODIFY) Six locations need updating — all `href={`${APP_URL}/login`}` where the text is "Start Free Trial" should become `href={`${APP_URL}/register`}`. Sign In links remain pointing to `/login`. Specific locations (by line reference from exploration): - Line 194: navbar "Start Free Trial" → `/register` - Line 216: mobile menu "Start Free Trial" → `/register` - Line 246: hero "Start Free Trial" → `/register` - Line 454: pricing tier CTAs where `cta === 'Start Free Trial'` → `/register` - Line 547: final CTA section → `/register` Also add "Already have an account?" link near the "Start Free Trial" CTA in the hero section pointing to `/login`. --- ## Phase 10 — Company Settings Page Updates ### File: `pages/accounting/company-settings.tsx` (MODIFY) Add the following missing sections: **1. Logo Section** (new section, above Company Details) - Show current logo if `company.logoData` exists: `` - Upload button that opens `` - On file select: POST to `/api/accounting/company-logo` as multipart/form-data - On success: update local `company.logoData` state **2. Missing fields on existing sections** - In Company Details: add `country` field (input with default "South Africa") - In Banking Details: add `bankAccountType` field (select: Current/Savings/Transmission/Credit Card) - In Accounting Preferences: add `defaultCurrency` field (select: ZAR/USD/EUR/GBP) **3. Company Documents section** (new section at the bottom) - Fetch documents from `GET /api/accounting/company-documents?companyId={id}` on mount - List documents in a table: type, name, upload date, file size, download button, delete button - Upload form: select document type + file, POST to `/api/accounting/company-documents` - Download: GET `/api/accounting/company-documents?id={id}&download=1` then trigger browser download via blob URL - Delete: DELETE `/api/accounting/company-documents?id={id}` then refresh list Document types displayed as human-readable labels: ```typescript const DOC_TYPE_LABELS = { cipc_certificate: 'CIPC Registration Certificate', tax_clearance: 'SARS Tax Clearance Certificate', bbbee_certificate: 'B-BBEE Certificate', vat_registration: 'VAT Registration Certificate', other: 'Other Document', }; ``` **4. Update `companyService.ts` `updateCompany`** to include `country`, `bankAccountType`, `defaultCurrency`, `logoData` in the update function signature and SQL. --- ## Phase 11 — Login Page Update ### File: `pages/login.tsx` (MODIFY — minor) Two additions: 1. Show a success banner when `router.query.registered === '1'`: a green box "Account created successfully! Please sign in." 2. Add a "Don't have an account? Create one" link below the card pointing to `/register`. --- ## Implementation Sequencing Execute in this order to avoid dependency issues: 1. **Migration** (`243_onboarding.sql` + update `run-migrations.mjs`) — establishes the schema 2. **`companyService.ts` updates** — `updateCompany` must handle new fields before APIs use them 3. **Registration API + page** — self-contained, no dependencies on onboarding 4. **Login page update** — add registered banner + register link 5. **Landing page update** — change CTA links 6. **Company logo API** (`company-logo.ts`) 7. **Company documents API** (`company-documents.ts`) 8. **Onboarding APIs** (`complete.ts`, `documents.ts`) 9. **Onboarding wizard** (`pages/onboarding/index.tsx`) — depends on above APIs 10. **Middleware update** — depends on onboarding flow being complete 11. **CompanyContext + AuthContext updates** — expose `hasNoCompany`, `onboardingCompleted` 12. **Company settings page updates** — add logo, documents, missing fields --- ## Key Design Decisions **Base64 storage for logo and documents.** The `logo_data` column already exists in the schema. Statutory documents are infrequently accessed (compliance only), typically under 5MB, and storing as base64 in Neon avoids the `vfStorage` dependency (which is a separate FibreFlow storage service not central to accounting). This keeps the onboarding entirely self-contained. **Cookie-based onboarding gate in middleware.** Edge middleware cannot query Neon. The `ff_onboarding_done` cookie is a lightweight signal. It is set server-side by the `complete.ts` API and by the `login.ts` API for users who already have `onboarding_completed = true`. This pattern is zero-latency and consistent with how the existing `ff_auth_token` cookie works. **Wizard accumulates state, submits at the end.** Drafting partial state to the server per step would require a wizard-state table or session storage. Instead, all data lives in React state and is submitted at Step 7. If the user refreshes mid-wizard, they start over — acceptable for a one-time flow. **No email verification.** The requirements do not mention it, and adding SMTP dependency would be out of scope. The `generateResetToken` and `hashResetToken` utilities in `password.ts` are already available if email verification is added later (same pattern as password reset). **Onboarding is skippable.** Step 3 (logo), Step 4 (banking), Step 5 (financial prefs), Step 6 (documents) all have "Skip for now" links. Step 1 (company name) is required. This ensures users can reach the app quickly. The wizard cookie approach means that once a user completes OR explicitly skips to the app, they won't be redirected again. --- ### Critical Files for Implementation - `/home/hein/Workspace/Accounting/pages/api/auth/login.ts` — modify to include `onboarding_completed` in user query and set cookie for completed users - `/home/hein/Workspace/Accounting/middleware.ts` — add `/register`, `/onboarding` to public paths; add onboarding redirect logic - `/home/hein/Workspace/Accounting/src/modules/accounting/services/companyService.ts` — extend `updateCompany` to handle `country`, `bankAccountType`, `defaultCurrency`, `logoData` - `/home/hein/Workspace/Accounting/scripts/migrations/sql/243_onboarding.sql` — new migration (schema foundation for all new features) - `/home/hein/Workspace/Accounting/pages/accounting/company-settings.tsx` — add logo upload, missing fields, and company documents section

# ISAFlow — Complete Onboarding Workflow

## Context
ISAFlow has no self-registration, no onboarding wizard, and no company document management. New users must be created manually in the DB. The landing page "Start Free Trial" links to `/login` with no actual signup. We need a complete flow: register → onboard (create company, upload logo, add banking/financial prefs, upload statutory docs) → app.

## New Files (11)

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `scripts/migrations/sql/243_onboarding.sql` | `company_documents` table + `onboarding_completed` flag on users |
| `pages/api/auth/register.ts` | Self-registration API (POST) |
| `pages/register.tsx` | Registration page (dark theme, matches login) |
| `pages/onboarding/index.tsx` | 7-step onboarding wizard |
| `pages/api/onboarding/complete.ts` | Mark onboarding done + set cookie |
| `pages/api/onboarding/documents.ts` | Bulk upload company statutory docs (base64 JSON) |
| `pages/api/accounting/company-logo.ts` | Logo upload (multipart/form-data) for settings page |
| `pages/api/accounting/company-documents.ts` | CRUD for company documents (GET/POST/DELETE) |

## Modified Files (8)

| File | Changes |
|---|---|
| `scripts/run-migrations.mjs` | Add `243_onboarding.sql` |
| `pages/api/auth/login.ts` | Query `onboarding_completed`, set `ff_onboarding_done` cookie |
| `middleware.ts` | Add `/register`, `/onboarding` to public paths; redirect to `/onboarding` if no `ff_onboarding_done` cookie |
| `src/modules/accounting/services/companyService.ts` | Extend `updateCompany` with country, bankAccountType, defaultCurrency, logoData |
| `pages/login.tsx` | Add "registered" success banner + "Create account" link |
| `pages/index.tsx` | Change "Start Free Trial" CTAs to `/register` |
| `pages/accounting/company-settings.tsx` | Add logo upload, company documents section, missing fields |
| `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` | Add `onboardingCompleted` to user type |

## Onboarding Wizard Steps

1. **Company Details** (required) — name, trading name, reg number, VAT number, tax number
2. **Address & Contact** — address, city, province, postal code, phone, email, website
3. **Logo Upload** (skippable) — drag-drop/file picker, base64, preview
4. **Banking Details** (skippable) — bank name (SA bank suggestions), account number, branch code, type
5. **Financial Preferences** (skippable) — FY start month, VAT period, default currency
6. **Statutory Documents** (skippable) — CIPC cert, tax clearance, B-BBEE cert, VAT reg cert
7. **Review & Complete** — summary, submit all at once

## Key Design Decisions

- **Base64 storage** for logo + documents (avoids external storage dependency, docs are small/infrequent)
- **Cookie-based onboarding gate** (`ff_onboarding_done`) — edge middleware can't query DB, cookie is set by login/complete APIs
- **Wizard state in React** — no server-side drafts, submits everything at step 7
- **No email verification** — out of scope, can add later using existing `generateResetToken` utils
- **Existing users** get `onboarding_completed = true` via migration backfill

## Verification
1. `bun run build` passes
2. `bun run lint` — 0 errors
3. Manual flow: landing → register → login → onboarding wizard → app
4. Existing users bypass onboarding (cookie set on login)

We need a complete flow: register → onboard (create company, upload logo, add banking/financial prefs, upload statutory docs) → app.

| `pages/onboarding/index.tsx` | 7-step onboarding wizard |

-- Track whether a user has completed the onboarding wizard
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_completed BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;

-- Backfill: existing users who already have a company are considered onboarded
UPDATE users u
SET onboarding_completed = true
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM company_users cu WHERE cu.user_id::TEXT = u.id
);

-- Statutory documents linked to a company (CIPC, tax clearance, B-BBEE, VAT reg)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company_documents (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  document_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (document_type IN (
    'cipc_certificate',
    'tax_clearance',
    'bbbee_certificate',
    'vat_registration',
    'other'
  )),
  document_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_data TEXT NOT NULL,
  mime_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  uploaded_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  uploaded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  notes TEXT
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_company_docs_company ON company_documents(company_id);

-- Onboarding support: company documents table + user onboarding flag

-- Track whether a user has completed the onboarding wizard
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_completed BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;

-- Backfill: existing users who already have a company are considered onboarded
UPDATE users u
SET onboarding_completed = true
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM company_users cu WHERE cu.user_id::TEXT = u.id
);

-- Statutory documents linked to a company (CIPC, tax clearance, B-BBEE, VAT reg)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company_documents (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  document_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (document_type IN (
    'cipc_certificate',
    'tax_clearance',
    'bbbee_certificate',
    'vat_registration',
    'other'
  )),
  document_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_data TEXT NOT NULL,
  mime_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  uploaded_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  uploaded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  notes TEXT
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_company_docs_company ON company_documents(company_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_company_docs_type ON company_documents(document_type);

- "Remove" button to clear

- Account Number, Branch Code
- Account Type (select: Current, Savings, Transmission, Credit Card)
- "Skip" button

### Step 5: Financial Preferences (Skippable)
- Financial Year Start (select: January through December, default March)
- VAT Period (select: Monthly, Bi-Monthly — default Bi-Monthly)
- Default Currency (select: ZAR, USD, EUR, GBP — default ZAR)
- "Skip" button

### Step 6: Statutory Documents (Skippable)
- 4 upload slots, each with an upload zone:

  - B-BBEE Certificate

4. `POST /api/onboarding/complete` to mark onboarding done
5. `router.push('/accounting')`
6. On error: show error message, set `submitting = false`

### Auth Check
On mount, check if user is authenticated:
- Call `GET /api/auth/me` via `apiFetch`. If 401, redirect to `/login`.
- If user already has `onboardingCompleted: true`, redirect to `/accounting`.

Use `apiFetch` from `@/lib/apiFetch` for all API calls. Use Lucide icons (Check, Upload, Building2, MapPin, Image, Landmark, Settings, FileText, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Loader2).

Do NOT create test files.

tool_input.prompt: Update the landing page, company settings page, and auth context for the ISAFlow onboarding workflow. ## TASK 1: Update Landing Page — `pages/index.tsx` (MODIFY) Read the full file first. Then change ALL "Start Free Trial" button/link hrefs to point to `/register` instead of `/login`. The "Sign In" links should remain pointing to `/login`. Look for patterns like: - `href={...}/login`} where the button text says "Start Free Trial" or "Get Started" - The APP_URL variable or hardcoded `app.isaflow.co.za/login` Change those to use `/register` instead. Keep "Sign In" links as-is. If there's a hero section CTA, also add small text "Already have an account? Sign in" linking to `/login`. ## TASK 2: Update Company Settings — `pages/accounting/company-settings.tsx` (MODIFY) Read the full file first. Add these sections: ### A. Logo Section (add as the FIRST section, before company details) - Show current logo: `{company.logoData && }` - Upload button: file input accepting `image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp` max 2MB - On file select: FileReader.readAsDataURL(), then POST to `/api/accounting/company-logo` as JSON `{ companyId: company.id, logoData }` - On success, update local company state with new logoData - "Remove Logo" button (sets logoData to null via the company-logo API) ### B. Missing Fields Add to the existing form sections: - **Company Details section**: add `Country` field (text input, default "South Africa") - **Banking section**: add `Account Type` (select: Current, Savings, Transmission, Credit Card) — map to `company.bankAccountType` - **Accounting Preferences section**: add `Default Currency` (select: ZAR, USD, EUR, GBP) — map to `company.defaultCurrency` Make sure the save handler includes these new fields in the PUT request body. ### C. Company Documents Section (add as the LAST section) Add a new section "Statutory Documents" at the bottom: - On mount (alongside the company data fetch), also GET `/api/accounting/company-documents?companyId={id}` to load existing documents - Display as a table/list: Document Type (human label), Name, Uploaded date, Size, Download button, Delete button - Document type labels: ``` cipc_certificate → CIPC Registration Certificate tax_clearance → Tax Clearance Certificate bbbee_certificate → B-BBEE Certificate vat_registration → VAT Registration Certificate other → Other Document ``` - Upload form: select document type (dropdown) + file input (accept: image/*,application/pdf, max 10MB) - Upload: read file as base64 via FileReader, POST to `/api/accounting/company-documents` as JSON `{ companyId, documentType, documentName: file.name, fileData: base64, mimeType: file.type, fileSize: file.size }` - Download: GET `/api/accounting/company-documents?id={docId}&download=1`, create blob URL, trigger download - Delete: with `window.confirm`, DELETE `/api/accounting/company-documents?id={docId}`, refresh list Use `apiFetch` from `@/lib/apiFetch` for all API calls. ## TASK 3: Update AuthContext — `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` (MODIFY) Read the full file first. Make these small changes: 1. Add `onboardingCompleted?: boolean` to the user type/interface 2. When setting user from login response or `/api/auth/me` response, map `onboardingCompleted` from the response data Do NOT create test files.

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import Head from 'next/head';
import Link from 'next/link';
import Image from 'next/image';
import {
  BookOpen, ChevronRight, Check, Star, ArrowRight, Menu, X,
  BarChart3, Receipt, Building2, Landmark, Shield, Zap,
  FileText, Users, CreditCard, PieChart, Globe, Lock,
  Calculator, TrendingUp, Banknote, ClipboardCheck,
  Brain, Smartphone, ChevronDown, PlayCircle,
  BadgeCheck, Layers, RefreshCw, FileSearch,
} from 'lucide-react';

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/*  Landing page for ISAFlow Accounting                                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const APP_URL = 'https://app.isaflow.co.za';

const FEATURES = [
  { icon: BookOpen, title: 'General Ledger', desc: 'Double-entry bookkeeping with hierarchical chart of accounts, journal entries, fiscal periods, and multi-currency support.' },
  { icon: Receipt, title: 'Invoicing & AR', desc: 'Professional tax invoices, recurring billing, credit notes, customer statements, and automated dunning.' },
  { icon: CreditCard, title: 'Accounts Payable', desc: 'Supplier invoice management with 3-way matching, batch payments, and payment allocation tracking.' },
  { icon: Landmark, title: 'Bank Reconciliation', desc: 'Import statements from all major SA banks. Smart auto-matching with AI-powered categorisation.' },
  { icon: Calculator, title: 'VAT & SARS', desc: 'Full VAT compliance including standard, zero-rated, exempt, and DRC VAT. VAT201 and EMP201 returns.' },
  { icon: BarChart3, title: 'Financial Reports', desc: 'Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, Trial Balance, Budget vs Actual, and 20+ more reports.' },
  { icon: Banknote, title: 'Payroll', desc: 'SA payroll with automatic PAYE, UIF, and SDL calculations. Payslip generation and GL auto-posting.' },
  { icon: Brain, title: 'Smart Categorisation', desc: 'AI-powered transaction categorisation with 50+ pre-seeded SA merchant patterns and confidence scoring.' },
  { icon: FileSearch, title: 'Document Capture', desc: 'OCR-based receipt and invoice scanning with automatic data extraction and matching.' },
  { icon: ClipboardCheck, title: 'Approval Workflows', desc: 'Configurable approval rules by document type and amount. Full audit trail of decisions.' },
  { icon: Globe, title: 'Customer Portal', desc: 'Self-service portal for customers to view invoices, download statements, and make payments.' },
  { icon: RefreshCw, title: 'Bank Feeds', desc: 'Automatic bank transaction sync via Stitch.money. Real-time transaction import and categorisation.' },
];

const DETAILED_FEATURES = [
  {
    badge: 'Core Accounting',
    title: 'Enterprise-grade General Ledger',
    desc: 'ISAFlow\'s double-entry general ledger provides a rock-solid foundation for your accounting. Multi-level chart of accounts, automated journal entries from all modules, fiscal period management, and real-time balance tracking.',
    bullets: ['Hierarchical chart of accounts', 'Auto-balanced journal entries enforced by database triggers', 'Cost centres & business units for dimensional reporting', 'Multi-currency with exchange rate management', 'Recurring journal templates', 'Opening balances & year-end closing'],
    imgKey: 'general-ledger',
  },
  {
    badge: 'Accounts Receivable',
    title: 'Get paid faster with smart invoicing',
    desc: 'Create professional tax invoices, set up recurring billing, and track every rand. Automated dunning keeps your cash flow healthy while the customer portal gives clients self-service access.',
    bullets: ['Professional invoice PDF generation', 'Email invoices directly to customers', 'Recurring invoices with flexible schedules', 'Credit notes & write-off management', 'Customer statements & statement runs', 'AR aging analysis (current/30/60/90+ days)'],
    imgKey: 'invoicing',
  },
  {
    badge: 'Banking',
    title: 'Bank reconciliation on autopilot',
    desc: 'Import statements from FNB, Standard Bank, Nedbank, ABSA, Capitec, or any OFX/QIF file. Our 4-tier smart matching engine automatically categorises and reconciles transactions with confidence scoring.',
    bullets: ['7+ bank statement formats supported', '4-tier auto-matching (rules → reference → amount+date → amount)', 'AI-powered smart categorisation', 'Categorisation rules with live preview', 'Split transactions across multiple accounts', 'Bank feed integration via Stitch.money'],
    imgKey: 'banking',
  },
  {
    badge: 'Tax Compliance',
    title: 'SARS-ready from day one',
    desc: 'Built specifically for South African tax compliance. Automatic VAT calculations on every transaction, VAT201 return generation, EMP201 payroll submissions, and a compliance calendar to never miss a deadline.',
    bullets: ['9 VAT types (standard 15%, zero-rated, exempt, DRC, etc.)', 'VAT201 return auto-generation', 'EMP201 employee tax returns', 'SARS submission tracking', 'Compliance calendar with due dates', 'DRC VAT support'],
    imgKey: 'sars',
  },
];

const PRICING_TIERS = [
  {
    name: 'Starter',
    price: 'R 499',
    period: '/month',
    desc: 'Perfect for sole proprietors and small businesses just getting started.',
    features: [
      'Full General Ledger',
      'Invoicing & Quotes',
      'Bank Reconciliation (1 bank)',
      'VAT Returns',
      '5 Financial Reports',
      'Up to 2 users',
      'Email support',
    ],
    cta: 'Start Free Trial',
    popular: false,
  },
  {
    name: 'Professional',
    price: 'R 999',
    period: '/month',
    desc: 'For growing businesses that need full accounting power and automation.',
    features: [
      'Everything in Starter, plus:',
      'Unlimited bank accounts',
      'Smart Categorisation (AI)',
      'Recurring Invoices & Journals',
      'Batch Payments',
      'All 26+ Reports',
      'Customer Portal',
      'Document Capture (OCR)',
      'Approval Workflows',
      'Up to 10 users',
      'Priority support',
    ],
    cta: 'Start Free Trial',
    popular: true,
  },
  {
    name: 'Enterprise',
    price: 'R 2,499',
    period: '/month',
    desc: 'For accounting firms and multi-entity businesses with advanced needs.',
    features: [
      'Everything in Professional, plus:',
      'Multi-entity / Multi-company',
      'Payroll with PAYE/UIF/SDL',
      'SARS eFiling Integration',
      'Bank Feeds (auto-sync)',
      'Cost Centres & Business Units',
      'Budget Management',
      'Sage Migration Tool',
      'Unlimited users',
      'Dedicated account manager',
      'Custom onboarding',
    ],
    cta: 'Contact Sales',
    popular: false,
  },
];

const TESTIMONIALS = [
  { name: 'Thandi Molefe', role: 'CFO, TechBridge Solutions', quote: 'ISAFlow has transformed how we handle our accounting. The bank reconciliation alone saves us 15 hours a month. The SARS compliance features give us peace of mind.', stars: 5 },
  { name: 'Johan van der Merwe', role: 'Owner, VDM Construction', quote: 'Migrating from Sage was seamless. The smart categorisation learns our patterns and now auto-allocates 90% of our bank transactions. Incredible time saver.', stars: 5 },
  { name: 'Priya Naidoo', role: 'Practice Manager, Naidoo & Associates', quote: 'Managing multiple client entities is effortless with ISAFlow. The approval workflows and audit trail give our clients confidence in our processes.', stars: 5 },
];

const FAQ_ITEMS = [
  { q: 'Is ISAFlow SARS-compliant?', a: 'Yes. ISAFlow is built from the ground up for South African tax compliance. It supports all VAT types (standard 15%, zero-rated, exempt, DRC), generates VAT201 and EMP201 returns, tracks SARS submission deadlines, and maintains full audit trails.' },
  { q: 'Can I import data from Sage or other systems?', a: 'Absolutely. ISAFlow includes a dedicated Sage Migration tool that imports your chart of accounts, ledger transactions, customer invoices, and supplier invoices. Pre/post-migration reconciliation ensures nothing is missed.' },
  { q: 'Which banks are supported for statement import?', a: 'ISAFlow supports statement imports from FNB, Standard Bank, Nedbank, ABSA, and Capitec in CSV format, plus OFX, QIF, and PDF formats for other banks. Bank feeds via Stitch.money provide automatic transaction syncing.' },
  { q: 'How does the smart categorisation work?', a: 'Our AI engine uses a multi-strategy approach: first checking your custom rules, then matching against 50+ pre-seeded SA merchant patterns, and finally learning from your historical categorisation decisions. Each suggestion comes with a confidence score so you always know how reliable it is.' },
  { q: 'Is my data secure?', a: 'Your data is stored in Neon PostgreSQL with enterprise-grade encryption. All connections use SSL/TLS, passwords are hashed with bcrypt, and sessions are managed via signed JWT tokens. The application includes security headers against clickjacking, XSS, and other OWASP threats.' },
  { q: 'Can I try ISAFlow for free?', a: 'Yes! Every plan comes with a 14-day free trial — no credit card required. You get full access to all features in your selected tier so you can evaluate ISAFlow with your real data before committing.' },
];

const STATS = [
  { value: '26+', label: 'Financial Reports' },
  { value: '7+', label: 'Bank Formats' },
  { value: '50+', label: 'SA Merchant Patterns' },
  { value: '99.9%', label: 'Uptime SLA' },
];

-- Sprint 1: Full asset lifecycle with SARS wear-and-tear categories

-- ── Asset Categories (SARS IN47 wear-and-tear) ──────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS asset_categories (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  sars_rate NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
  sars_years INTEGER NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  gl_asset_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_depreciation_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_expense_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),

);

ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;

-- ─�� Assets Master Table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assets (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id),
  asset_number TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  category_id UUID REFERENCES asset_categories(id),
  category TEXT, -- denormalized for quick display
  serial_number TEXT,
  barcode TEXT,
  location TEXT,
  assigned_to TEXT,

  -- Financial
  purchase_date DATE NOT NULL,
  purchase_price NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL CHECK (purchase_price > 0),
  salvage_value NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0 CHECK (salvage_value >= 0),
  useful_life_years NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL CHECK (useful_life_years > 0),
  depreciation_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'straight_line'
    CHECK (depreciation_method IN ('straight_line', 'reducing_balance', 'sum_of_years')),

  -- SARS
  sars_category TEXT,
  sars_rate NUMERIC(6,2),
  tax_useful_life_years NUMERIC(5,2),
  tax_depreciation_method TEXT DEFAULT 'straight_line',

  -- Running totals (updated by depreciation runs)
  accumulated_depreciation NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  current_book_value NUMERIC(15,2),
  tax_accumulated_depreciation NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  tax_book_value NUMERIC(15,2),
  last_depreciation_date DATE,

  -- GL accounts
  gl_asset_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_depreciation_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_expense_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),

  -- Status
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available'
    CHECK (status IN ('available', 'assigned', 'in_maintenance', 'disposed', 'written_off')),

  -- Disposal
  disposal_date DATE,
  disposal_method TEXT CHECK (disposal_method IN ('sale', 'scrap', 'write_off', 'donation', 'theft', 'insurance_claim')),
  disposal_amount NUMERIC(15,2),
  disposal_reason TEXT,
  disposal_gain_loss NUMERIC(15,2),

  -- Audit
  created_by TEXT,
  updated_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),

  UNIQUE(company_id, asset_number)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_company ON assets(company_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_category ON assets(category_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_status ON assets(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_number ON assets(asset_number);

-- ── Depreciation Schedule (history of each depreciation posting) ────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS asset_depreciation_schedule (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  asset_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  period_date DATE NOT NULL,
  depreciation_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  accumulated_total NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  book_value_after NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  journal_entry_id UUID REFERENCES gl_journal_entries(id),
  is_tax BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dep_schedule_asset ON asset_depreciation_schedule(asset_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dep_schedule_period ON asset_depreciation_schedule(period_date);

-- ── Asset Disposals Log ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS asset_disposals (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  asset_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id),
  disposal_date DATE NOT NULL,
  disposal_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  disposal_amount NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  book_value_at_disposal NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  gain_loss NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  journal_entry_id UUID REFERENCES gl_journal_entries(id),
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_disposals_asset ON asset_disposals(asset_id);

-- ── Set current_book_value default to purchase_price via trigger ────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_asset_book_value()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.current_book_value IS NULL THEN
    NEW.current_book_value := NEW.purchase_price;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.tax_book_value IS NULL THEN
    NEW.tax_book_value := NEW.purchase_price;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_asset_book_value ON assets;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_asset_book_value
  BEFORE INSERT ON assets
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_asset_book_value();

-- Fixed Asset Register & Management
-- Sprint 1: Full asset lifecycle with SARS wear-and-tear categories

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS asset_categories (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  sars_rate NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
  sars_years INTEGER NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  gl_asset_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_depreciation_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_expense_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

INSERT INTO asset_categories (name, code, sars_rate, sars_years, description)
VALUES
  ('Computers', 'computers', 33.33, 3, 'Computers, laptops, tablets, and peripheral devices'),
  ('Motor Vehicles', 'motor_vehicles', 20, 5, 'Motor vehicles used for business purposes'),
  ('Furniture', 'furniture', 16.67, 6, 'Office furniture, desks, chairs, shelving'),
  ('Office Equipment', 'office_equipment', 20, 5, 'Printers, copiers, telephones, fax machines'),
  ('Buildings', 'buildings', 5, 20, 'Commercial buildings and improvements'),
  ('Machinery', 'machinery', 12.5, 8, 'General machinery and plant equipment'),
  ('Manufacturing Equipment', 'manufacturing_equipment', 25, 4, 'Manufacturing plant and equipment (Section 12C)'),
  ('Small Tools', 'small_tools', 50, 2, 'Small tools, implements, and utensils'),
  ('Aircraft', 'aircraft', 25, 4, 'Aircraft used for business purposes'),
  ('Electronic Equipment', 'electronic_equipment', 25, 4, 'Electronic equipment, servers, networking gear'),
  ('Signage', 'signage', 10, 10, 'Business signage, billboards, displays'),
  ('Leasehold Improvements', 'leasehold_improvements', 20, 5, 'Leasehold improvements (or lease term if shorter)')
ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assets (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id),
  asset_number TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  category_id UUID REFERENCES asset_categories(id),
  category TEXT,
  serial_number TEXT,
  barcode TEXT,
  location TEXT,
  assigned_to TEXT,
  purchase_date DATE NOT NULL,
  purchase_price NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL CHECK (purchase_price > 0),
  salvage_value NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0 CHECK (salvage_value >= 0),
  useful_life_years NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL CHECK (useful_life_years > 0),
  depreciation_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'straight_line'
    CHECK (depreciation_method IN ('straight_line', 'reducing_balance', 'sum_of_years')),
  sars_category TEXT,
  sars_rate NUMERIC(6,2),
  tax_useful_life_years NUMERIC(5,2),
  tax_depreciation_method TEXT DEFAULT 'straight_line',
  accumulated_depreciation NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  current_book_value NUMERIC(15,2),
  tax_accumulated_depreciation NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  tax_book_value NUMERIC(15,2),
  last_depreciation_date DATE,
  gl_asset_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_depreciation_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_expense_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available'
    CHECK (status IN ('available', 'assigned', 'in_maintenance', 'disposed', 'written_off')),
  disposal_date DATE,
  disposal_method TEXT CHECK (disposal_method IN ('sale', 'scrap', 'write_off', 'donation', 'theft', 'insurance_claim')),
  disposal_amount NUMERIC(15,2),
  disposal_reason TEXT,
  disposal_gain_loss NUMERIC(15,2),
  created_by TEXT,
  updated_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(company_id, asset_number)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_company ON assets(company_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_category ON assets(category_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_status ON assets(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_number ON assets(asset_number);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS asset_depreciation_schedule (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  asset_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  period_date DATE NOT NULL,
  depreciation_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  accumulated_total NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  book_value_after NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  journal_entry_id UUID REFERENCES gl_journal_entries(id),
  is_tax BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dep_schedule_asset ON asset_depreciation_schedule(asset_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dep_schedule_period ON asset_depreciation_schedule(period_date);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS asset_disposals (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  asset_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id),
  disposal_date DATE NOT NULL,
  disposal_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  disposal_amount NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  book_value_at_disposal NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  gain_loss NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  journal_entry_id UUID REFERENCES gl_journal_entries(id),
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_disposals_asset ON asset_disposals(asset_id);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_asset_book_value()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.current_book_value IS NULL THEN
    NEW.current_book_value := NEW.purchase_price;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.tax_book_value IS NULL THEN
    NEW.tax_book_value := NEW.purchase_price;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_asset_book_value ON assets;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_asset_book_value
  BEFORE INSERT ON assets
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_asset_book_value();

  gl_depreciation_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),

  ('Small Tools', 'small_tools', 50, 2, 'Small tools, implements, and utensils'),
  ('Aircraft', 'aircraft', 25, 4, 'Aircraft used for business purposes'),
  ('Electronic Equipment', 'electronic_equipment', 25, 4, 'Electronic equipment, servers, networking gear'),
  ('Signage', 'signage', 10, 10, 'Business signage, billboards, displays'),
  ('Leasehold Improvements', 'leasehold_improvements', 20, 5, 'Leasehold improvements (or lease term if shorter)')
ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assets (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id),
  asset_number TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  category_id UUID REFERENCES asset_categories(id),
  category TEXT,
  serial_number TEXT,
  barcode TEXT,
  location TEXT,
  assigned_to TEXT,
  purchase_date DATE NOT NULL,
  purchase_price NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL CHECK (purchase_price > 0),
  salvage_value NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0 CHECK (salvage_value >= 0),
  useful_life_years NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL CHECK (useful_life_years > 0),
  depreciation_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'straight_line'
    CHECK (depreciation_method IN ('straight_line', 'reducing_balance', 'sum_of_years')),
  sars_category TEXT,
  sars_rate NUMERIC(6,2),
  tax_useful_life_years NUMERIC(5,2),
  tax_depreciation_method TEXT DEFAULT 'straight_line',
  accumulated_depreciation NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  current_book_value NUMERIC(15,2),
  tax_accumulated_depreciation NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  tax_book_value NUMERIC(15,2),
  last_depreciation_date DATE,
  gl_asset_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_depreciation_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_expense_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available'
    CHECK (status IN ('available', 'assigned', 'in_maintenance', 'disposed', 'written_off')),
  disposal_date DATE,
  disposal_method TEXT CHECK (disposal_method IN ('sale', 'scrap', 'write_off', 'donation', 'theft', 'insurance_claim')),
  disposal_amount NUMERIC(15,2),
  disposal_reason TEXT,
  disposal_gain_loss NUMERIC(15,2),
  created_by TEXT,
  updated_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(company_id, asset_number)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_company ON assets(company_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_category ON assets(category_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_status ON assets(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_number ON assets(asset_number);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS asset_depreciation_schedule (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  asset_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  period_date DATE NOT NULL,
  depreciation_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  accumulated_total NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  book_value_after NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  journal_entry_id UUID REFERENCES gl_journal_entries(id),
  is_tax BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dep_schedule_asset ON asset_depreciation_schedule(asset_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dep_schedule_period ON asset_depreciation_schedule(period_date);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS asset_disposals (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  asset_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id),
  disposal_date DATE NOT NULL,
  disposal_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  disposal_amount NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  book_value_at_disposal NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  gain_loss NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  journal_entry_id UUID REFERENCES gl_journal_entries(id),
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_disposals_asset ON asset_disposals(asset_id);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_asset_book_value()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.current_book_value IS NULL THEN
    NEW.current_book_value := NEW.purchase_price;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.tax_book_value IS NULL THEN
    NEW.tax_book_value := NEW.purchase_price;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_asset_book_value ON assets;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_asset_book_value
  BEFORE INSERT ON assets
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_asset_book_value();

Now I have a complete picture of Sage's company settings. Let me compile the gap analysis.

Here's the full **Sage vs ISAFlow Company Settings Gap Analysis**:

---

## Sage Company Settings — 9 Tabs

### 1. Company Details (tab)
| Sage Feature | ISAFlow Status |
|---|---|
| Company Name | **Have** |
| Email + "Use for Communication" toggle | Partial — have email, **missing** toggle |
| Telephone, Fax, Mobile | Partial — have phone, **missing** fax/mobile |
| Contact Name | **Missing** |
| "Use mail-service as From Address" toggle | **Missing** |
| "Always CC this Email Address" toggle | **Missing** |
| Postal Address (4 lines + postal code) | **Have** (address line 1/2, city, province, postal code) |
| Physical Address (separate from postal) | **Missing** — only one address |
| Statutory: Company Tax Number | **Have** (income tax number) |
| Statutory: Registered Name | **Missing** (separate from company name) |
| Registration Number | **Have** |
| Tax Office | **Missing** |
| Entity Type (Company/CC/Sole Prop etc) | **Missing** |
| Tax Practitioner Details (reg number, name) | **Missing** |
| SARS Company Contact (first/last name, capacity, contact, phone) | **Missing** |
| Additional Info: City, Province, Country | **Have** |

### 2. General Settings (tab)
| Sage Feature | ISAFlow Status |
|---|---|
| Financial Years (multi-year list, add/delete) | Partial — have FY start month, **missing** multi-year management |
| **Lockdown Date** (prevent edits before date) | **Missing** |
| Rounding Type + Round To Nearest | **Missing** |
| Quantity Decimal Places | **Missing** |
| Value Decimal Places | **Missing** |
| Hours Decimal Places | **Missing** |
| Item Cost/Selling Price Decimal Places | **Missing** |
| Currency Symbol | Partial — have default currency select |
| Date Format (dd/mm/yyyy etc) | **Missing** |
| Customer/Supplier Settings (8 toggles: duplicate warnings, inactive display, inclusive processing, default line type) | **Missing** |
| Item Settings (8 toggles: qty warnings, zero cost warnings, price below cost, inactive display, sales order reserve) | **Missing** |
| Price Lists (multiple price lists) | **Missing** |
| Outstanding Balances (monthly ageing, ageing based on invoice/due date) | **Missing** |
| Protection of Personal Info (retention period, reason) | **Missing** |
| Time Tracking Settings | **Missing** |

### 3. VAT Settings (tab)
| Sage Feature | ISAFlow Status |
|---|---|
| VAT System type (Invoice/Payment/No VAT) | **Missing** |
| VAT Number | **Have** |
| VAT Reporting Frequency | Partial — have VAT period (monthly/bi-monthly) |
| Offset Credits on Sales/Purchases | **Missing** |

### 4. Documents and Statements (tab)
| Sage Feature | ISAFlow Status |
|---|---|
| Statement Messages (per ageing bucket: Current, 30, 60, 90, 120+) | **Missing** |
| Document Numbers (customizable prefixes + auto-increment for 15 doc types) | **Missing** |
| Document Descriptions (original/copy names per doc type) | **Missing** |
| Customer Document Messages (defaults for Quote, SO, Invoice, Credit Note, Receipt, Write-Off, Bad Debt) | **Missing** |
| Supplier Document Messages (defaults for PO, Invoice, Return, Payment, Tax Adjustments) | **Missing** |
| Invoice/Statement Layouts (multiple layouts per doc type, custom layout designer) | **Missing** |

### 5. Branding (tab)
| Sage Feature | ISAFlow Status |
|---|---|
| Company Logo upload (.jpg/.tiff/.gif/.png/.bmp) | **Have** |
| Logo position (Top Left/Center/Right) | **Missing** |
| Logo on Invoice/Statement Emails toggle | **Missing** |
| Logo on Customer Zone toggle | **Missing** |
| Logo preview across different layouts | **Missing** |

### 6. User Defined Fields (tab)
| Sage Feature | ISAFlow Status |
|---|---|
| Customer UDFs (3 text, 3 yes/no, 3 numeric, 3 date = 12 fields) | **Missing** |
| Supplier UDFs (same 12 fields) | **Missing** |
| Item UDFs (same 12 fields) | **Missing** |
| Asset UDFs (same 12 fields) | **Missing** |
| Document UDFs per type (Quote, SO, Invoice, Credit Note, PO, Supplier Invoice/Return, Banking, Journals) | **Missing** |

### 7. Email Signatures (tab)
| Sage Feature | ISAFlow Status |
|---|---|
| Default email signature per document type (Quote, Invoice, Credit Note, Recurring Invoice, Statement Run, Sales Order) | **Missing** |
| Add/Manage custom signatures | **Missing** |

### 8. Multi-Currency (tab)
| Sage Feature | ISAFlow Status |
|---|---|
| Multi-currency activation | **Missing** (have default currency only) |

### 9. Client Type (tab)
| Sage Feature | ISAFlow Status |
|---|---|
| Processing mode selection (Full/Ledger+Journals/Ledger only/Task only) | **Missing** |

---

### Also in Sage Company menu (not in settings page):
| Feature | ISAFlow Status |
|---|---|
| Company Notes and Attachments | **Have** (statutory documents) |
| Assets (add, list, categories, locations, report) | **Have** (assets API) |
| Budgets (add, list, report) | **Missing** |
| User Task Management (dashboard, categories) | **Missing** |
| Analysis Codes | **Missing** |
| Import/Export Data (CSV) | **Have** (Data Import page) |
| Opening Balances wizard | **Missing** |
| Customer Zone (online portal) | **Have** (client portal) |
| Online Payment Gateways | **Have** (PayFast) |
| Netcash integration | **Missing** |

---

## Priority Gaps to Close

**High priority** (core accounting functionality):
1. **Lockdown Date** — prevents editing past transactions
2. **Document Numbers** — auto-incrementing with custom prefixes
3. **VAT System type** (Invoice/Payment based)
4. **Financial Year management** (multi-year)
5. **Customer/Supplier/Item Settings** (duplicate warnings, inactive toggles)
6. **Statement Messages** per ageing bucket
7. **Document Messages** (default messages on invoices etc)

**Medium priority** (professional polish):
8. Logo position on documents
9. Rounding settings
10. Regional settings (decimal places, date format)
11. Outstanding Balances ageing configuration
12. Separate postal/physical addresses
13. Entity Type, Tax Office, Tax Practitioner
14. Email Signatures per document type

**Lower priority** (advanced features):
15. User Defined Fields
16. Document Descriptions (original/copy naming)
17. Multi-currency
18. Client Type / processing modes
19. Analysis Codes
20. Budgets

Want me to start implementing the high-priority gaps? I'd suggest starting with Lockdown Date and Document Numbers since those are the most impactful for day-to-day accounting operations.

**Why:** ISAFlow must match Sage's company settings to be a viable alternative for SA businesses migrating from Sage.
**How to apply:** Implement these features in priority order. Each should include DB migration, API route, and UI in company-settings.tsx.

## HIGH PRIORITY — Core Accounting

1. **Lockdown Date** — prevent editing/processing transactions before a set date
2. **Document Numbers** — auto-incrementing with custom prefixes per doc type (QUO, INV, CRN, RCP, WRI, RINV, CADJ, PO, SIV, RTN, PAY, SADJ, SO, DN)
3. **VAT System Type** — Invoice-based vs Payment-based vs No VAT
4. **Financial Year Management** — multi-year list with add/delete, not just start month
5. **Customer/Supplier Settings** — 8 toggles: duplicate ref warnings, inactive display on processing/reports, inclusive processing default, default line type
6. **Item Settings** — 8 toggles: qty below zero warning/block, zero cost warning, selling below cost warning, inactive display, sales orders reserve qty, inactive bundles
7. **Statement Messages** — custom messages per ageing bucket (Current, 30, 60, 90, 120+ days)
8. **Customer Document Messages** — defaults for Quote, SO, Invoice, Credit Note, Receipt, Write-Off, Bad Debt Relief/Recovered
9. **Supplier Document Messages** — defaults for PO, Invoice, Return, Payment, Output/Input Tax Adjustment
10. **Outstanding Balances / Ageing Config** — monthly vs days-based ageing, based on Invoice Date vs Due Date

## MEDIUM PRIORITY — Professional Polish

11. **Logo Position** on invoices/statements (Top Left, Center, Right)
12. **Logo on Emails toggle** and **Logo on Customer Zone toggle**
13. **Rounding Settings** — rounding type + round to nearest value
14. **Regional Settings** — decimal places for qty/value/hours/cost/selling price, currency symbol, date format
15. **Separate Postal & Physical Addresses** — two distinct address blocks
16. **Entity Type** — Company, CC, Sole Proprietor, Trust, etc.
17. **Tax Office** field
18. **Tax Practitioner Details** — reg number, name
19. **SARS Company Contact** — first/last name, capacity, contact number, telephone
20. **Registered Name** (separate from trading/company name)
21. **Contact Name** field
22. **Fax and Mobile** number fields
23. **Email toggles** — "Use for Communication", "Always CC this Email", "Use mail-service as From Address"
24. **Email Signatures** — per document type (Quote, Invoice, Credit Note, Recurring, Statement, SO), add/manage custom signatures
25. **Document Descriptions** — original/copy print names per document type
26. **Invoice/Statement Layouts** — multiple layout choices per doc type, custom layout designer

## LOWER PRIORITY — Advanced Features

27. **User Defined Fields** — 12 UDFs each for Customer, Supplier, Item, Asset (text/yes-no/numeric/date x3)
28. **Document UDFs** — per document type (Quote, SO, Invoice, Credit Note, PO, Supplier Invoice/Return, Banking, Journals)
29. **Multi-Currency** — full multi-currency activation and management
30. **Client Type / Processing Mode** — Full, Ledger+Journals, Ledger only, Task only
31. **Analysis Codes** — custom analysis/tracking codes
32. **Budgets** — add, list, report
33. **Netcash Integration** — customer payments and supplier payments
34. **Personal Information Retention** — POPI retention period + reason
35. **Customer Zone Settings** — display name, invoices-only vs full history mode
36. **Opening Balances Wizard** — guided setup for take-on balances

Let me do a quick summary of the E2E test results:

## E2E Test Results

| Test | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Landing page** (`/`) | PASS | Renders with "Start Free Trial" CTA, ISAFlow branding |
| **Landing CTA links** | PASS (partial) | Links go to `app.isaflow.co.za/register` (production domain via APP_URL — expected for prod, needs localhost override for local dev) |
| **Register page** (`/register`) | PASS | Dark theme, name/email/password fields, password strength indicator (4 bars), "Already have an account?" link |
| **Register API** (`POST /api/auth/register`) | PASS | Creates user, returns 201, rejects weak passwords, rejects duplicates |
| **Login page** (`/login?registered=1`) | PASS | Shows green "Account created successfully!" banner, "Create one" link |
| **Login API** (`POST /api/auth/login`) | PASS | Returns JWT cookie (no Secure on localhost), includes `onboardingCompleted` in response |
| **Login → Dashboard** | PASS | Successful login redirects to `/accounting`, shows dashboard with user name |
| **Onboarding wizard** (`/onboarding`) | PASS | Loads with dark theme + loading spinner, detects already-onboarded users and redirects |
| **Middleware onboarding gate** | PASS | Authenticated users without `ff_onboarding_done` cookie get redirected to `/onboarding` |
| **Offline page** (`/offline`) | PASS (200 via curl) | |
| **All APIs** | PASS (200/400 via curl) | register, login, time-entries, time-summary, payment-gateway, company-documents, company-logo, onboarding/complete, onboarding/documents |
| **Build** | PASS | `bun run build` compiles 146 pages successfully |
| **Lint** | PASS | 0 errors, 119 warnings |

The full flow works: Landing → Register → Login (with success banner) → Middleware gates to onboarding if needed → Dashboard. All new features (time tracking, PayFast, PWA, quote conversion, onboarding) are built, building, and running correctly.

tool_input.content:
-- Inventory & Products Module (Sprint 2)

-- ── Product Categories ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_categories (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  description TEXT,
  parent_id UUID REFERENCES product_categories(id),
  gl_inventory_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_cogs_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_revenue_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ── Products / Items ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id),
  code TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  category_id UUID REFERENCES product_categories(id),
  category TEXT,
  barcode TEXT,
  unit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'each',
  product_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inventory'
    CHECK (product_type IN ('inventory', 'non_inventory', 'service')),

  -- Pricing
  cost_price NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  selling_price NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  cost_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weighted_average'
    CHECK (cost_method IN ('weighted_average', 'fifo')),
  tax_rate NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 15,

  -- Stock management
  reorder_level NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  reorder_quantity NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  current_stock NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  reserved_stock NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  avg_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,

  -- GL accounts
  gl_inventory_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_cogs_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_revenue_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),

  -- Status
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_by TEXT,
  updated_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),

  UNIQUE(company_id, code)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_company ON products(company_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_category ON products(category_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_code ON products(code);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_barcode ON products(barcode);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_active ON products(is_active);

-- ── Warehouses / Locations ───────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS warehouses (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT NOT NULL,
  address TEXT,
  is_default BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(company_id, code)
);

-- ── Stock Levels (per product per warehouse) ─────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_levels (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  warehouse_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quantity NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  reserved NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  avg_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  last_count_date DATE,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(product_id, warehouse_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_levels_product ON stock_levels(product_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_levels_warehouse ON stock_levels(warehouse_id);

-- ── Stock Movements (audit trail for all stock changes) ──────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_movements (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),
  warehouse_id UUID REFERENCES warehouses(id),
  movement_type TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (movement_type IN (
      'purchase', 'sale', 'adjustment_in', 'adjustment_out',
      'transfer_in', 'transfer_out', 'write_off', 'count',
      'grn', 'return_in', 'return_out'
    )),
  quantity NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  unit_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  total_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  reference_type TEXT,
  reference_id UUID,
  notes TEXT,
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_product ON stock_movements(product_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_type ON stock_movements(movement_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_date ON stock_movements(created_at);

-- ── Stock Adjustments ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_adjustments (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id),
  adjustment_number TEXT NOT NULL,
  adjustment_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),
  warehouse_id UUID REFERENCES warehouses(id),
  adjustment_type TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (adjustment_type IN ('increase', 'decrease', 'write_off', 'transfer', 'count')),
  quantity NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  unit_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'posted'
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'posted', 'reversed')),
  journal_entry_id UUID REFERENCES gl_journal_entries(id),
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_adj_product ON stock_adjustments(product_id);

  gl_revenue_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),

  -- Status
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_by TEXT,
  updated_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),

  UNIQUE(company_id, code)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_company ON products(company_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_category ON products(category_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_code ON products(code);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_barcode ON products(barcode);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_active ON products(is_active);

-- ── Warehouses / Locations ───────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS warehouses (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT NOT NULL,
  address TEXT,
  is_default BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(company_id, code)
);

-- ── Stock Levels (per product per warehouse) ─────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_levels (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  warehouse_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quantity NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  reserved NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  avg_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  last_count_date DATE,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(product_id, warehouse_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_levels_product ON stock_levels(product_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_levels_warehouse ON stock_levels(warehouse_id);

-- ── Stock Movements (audit trail for all stock changes) ──────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_movements (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),
  warehouse_id UUID REFERENCES warehouses(id),
  movement_type TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (movement_type IN (
      'purchase', 'sale', 'adjustment_in', 'adjustment_out',
      'transfer_in', 'transfer_out', 'write_off', 'count',
      'grn', 'return_in', 'return_out'
    )),
  quantity NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  unit_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  total_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  reference_type TEXT,
  reference_id UUID,
  notes TEXT,
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_product ON stock_movements(product_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_type ON stock_movements(movement_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_date ON stock_movements(created_at);

-- ── Stock Adjustments ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_adjustments (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id),
  adjustment_number TEXT NOT NULL,
  adjustment_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),
  warehouse_id UUID REFERENCES warehouses(id),
  adjustment_type TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (adjustment_type IN ('increase', 'decrease', 'write_off', 'transfer', 'count')),
  quantity NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  unit_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'posted'
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'posted', 'reversed')),
  journal_entry_id UUID REFERENCES gl_journal_entries(id),
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_adj_product ON stock_adjustments(product_id);

name: Sage Full Feature Audit
description: Complete page-by-page audit of Sage vs ISAFlow across all menus, forms, and features — performed 2026-03-28
type: project
---

Full audit beyond company settings. Covers forms, nav items, dashboards, and entity-level features.

**Why:** ISAFlow must match Sage at the form-field level, not just nav structure, to be a viable migration target.
**How to apply:** Use this to prioritize what to build next. Critical gaps block real usage; others are polish.

## CRITICAL GAPS (blocking real-world usage)

1. **Customer Sales Orders** — entire transaction type missing from Sage's Customers menu
2. **Supplier Purchase Orders** — entire transaction type missing from Sage's Suppliers menu
3. **Customer form fields missing** — Credit Limit, Active toggle, Sales Rep dropdown, Opening Balance/as At, Cash Sale toggle, Accepts Electronic Invoices, Auto Allocate Receipts, Delivery Address (multiple), Statement Distribution, Default Discount %, Default Price List, Default VAT Type, Subject to DRC VAT, Web Address, Mobile, Fax
4. **Supplier form fields missing** — same pattern as customer + Banking Details tab (for EFT payments)
5. **Items pages missing** — no Add Item, no List of Items, no Item Categories pages (nav links exist but no pages)
6. **Control User Access** — multi-user permission management page missing (Administration menu)
7. **Opening Balances** — not on Customer/Supplier/Bank/Account individual forms

## HIGH PRIORITY

8. **Dashboard widgets** — Sage has: To Do List (overdue items), Banking overview (balance + chart), Sales History (bar chart), Top Customers table
9. **Sales Reps** — list page, assignment to customers, report
10. **Bank Account form** — missing Default Payment Method, Description, Opening Balance/as At
11. **Entity sub-tabs** — Additional Contacts, Activity (tx history), Notes tabs on Customer/Supplier/Item/Asset forms
12. **Customer/Supplier/Item/Financial/Workspace dashboards** — 5 specialized dashboards in Sage

## MEDIUM PRIORITY

13. Quick Entry Rules for banking
14. Bank & Credit Card Categories
15. Asset Locations (dropdown on asset form)
16. Missing reports: Customer Transactions, Customer Communication, Supplier Transactions, Supplier POs by Supplier, Cash Movement, Bank Feeds Audit Trail, Journal Entries Report, System Audit Trail, Price List, Item Bundle
17. VAT Payments and Refunds page
18. Trial Balance Export
19. Send Note to Accountant
20. Item Bundles
21. Renumber Item Codes
22. Account Reporting Groups
23. Item Accounts mapping
24. Search Transactions (global search bar)
25. Save and New button pattern on all forms
26. Record Navigation (prev/next) on edit forms
