-- Migration 201: Accounts Payable
-- PRD-060: FibreFlow Accounting Module - Phase 2
-- Supplier Invoices, Payments, 3-Way Matching, Auto-GL Posting

-- ── Extend GL Journal Entry Source Types ─────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE gl_journal_entries DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS gl_journal_entries_source_check;
ALTER TABLE gl_journal_entries ADD CONSTRAINT gl_journal_entries_source_check
  CHECK (source IN (
    'manual', 'auto_invoice', 'auto_payment', 'auto_grn',
    'auto_credit_note', 'auto_bank_recon',
    'auto_supplier_invoice', 'auto_supplier_payment'
  ));

-- ── Supplier Invoices ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supplier_invoices (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  invoice_number VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  supplier_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers(id),
  purchase_order_id UUID,
  grn_id UUID,
  invoice_date DATE NOT NULL,
  due_date DATE,
  received_date DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  subtotal NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  tax_rate NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 15.00,
  tax_amount NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  total_amount NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  amount_paid NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  balance NUMERIC(15,2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (total_amount - amount_paid) STORED,
  payment_terms VARCHAR(50),
  currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'ZAR',
  reference VARCHAR(255),
  status VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN (
    'draft', 'pending_approval', 'approved', 'partially_paid', 'paid', 'disputed', 'cancelled'
  )),
  match_status VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'unmatched' CHECK (match_status IN (
    'unmatched', 'po_matched', 'grn_matched', 'fully_matched'
  )),
  project_id UUID,
  cost_center_id UUID,
  gl_journal_entry_id UUID REFERENCES gl_journal_entries(id),
  sage_invoice_id VARCHAR(100),
  notes TEXT,
  created_by UUID NOT NULL,
  approved_by UUID,
  approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_si_supplier ON supplier_invoices(supplier_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_si_po ON supplier_invoices(purchase_order_id) WHERE purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_si_status ON supplier_invoices(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_si_match ON supplier_invoices(match_status);
CREATE INDEX idx_si_due_date ON supplier_invoices(due_date) WHERE due_date IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_si_date ON supplier_invoices(invoice_date);

-- ── Supplier Invoice Items ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supplier_invoice_items (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  supplier_invoice_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES supplier_invoices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  po_item_id UUID,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity NUMERIC(12,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  unit_price NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  tax_rate NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 15.00,
  tax_amount NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  line_total NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  gl_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  project_id UUID,
  cost_center_id UUID,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_sii_invoice ON supplier_invoice_items(supplier_invoice_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_sii_po_item ON supplier_invoice_items(po_item_id) WHERE po_item_id IS NOT NULL;

-- ── Supplier Payments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supplier_payments (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  payment_number VARCHAR(30),
  supplier_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers(id),
  payment_date DATE NOT NULL,
  total_amount NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  payment_method VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'eft' CHECK (payment_method IN ('eft', 'cheque', 'cash', 'card')),
  bank_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  reference VARCHAR(255),
  description TEXT,
  status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN (
    'draft', 'approved', 'processed', 'reconciled', 'cancelled'
  )),
  gl_journal_entry_id UUID REFERENCES gl_journal_entries(id),
  batch_id UUID,
  created_by UUID NOT NULL,
  approved_by UUID,
  approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_sp_supplier ON supplier_payments(supplier_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_sp_status ON supplier_payments(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_sp_date ON supplier_payments(payment_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_sp_batch ON supplier_payments(batch_id) WHERE batch_id IS NOT NULL;

-- ── Payment Allocations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payment_allocations (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  payment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES supplier_payments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  invoice_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES supplier_invoices(id),
  amount_allocated NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount_allocated > 0),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(payment_id, invoice_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_pa_payment ON payment_allocations(payment_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_pa_invoice ON payment_allocations(invoice_id);

-- ── Triggers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Auto-generate payment number (SP-YYYY-NNNNN)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION generate_supplier_payment_number()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
DECLARE
  pay_year INT;
  next_seq INT;
BEGIN
  pay_year := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NEW.payment_date);
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(
    CAST(SPLIT_PART(payment_number, '-', 3) AS INT)
  ), 0) + 1 INTO next_seq
  FROM supplier_payments
  WHERE payment_number LIKE 'SP-' || pay_year || '-%';

  NEW.payment_number := 'SP-' || pay_year || '-' || LPAD(next_seq::TEXT, 5, '0');
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sp_payment_number
  BEFORE INSERT ON supplier_payments
  FOR EACH ROW
  WHEN (NEW.payment_number IS NULL)
  EXECUTE FUNCTION generate_supplier_payment_number();

-- Auto-update updated_at timestamps
CREATE TRIGGER trg_supplier_invoices_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON supplier_invoices
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION accounting_updated_at();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_supplier_payments_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON supplier_payments
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION accounting_updated_at();

-- Migration 200: Accounting Module Foundation
-- PRD-060: FibreFlow Accounting Module - Phase 1
-- GL Engine, Chart of Accounts, Fiscal Periods

-- ── GL Accounts (Chart of Accounts) ─────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gl_accounts (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  account_code VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  account_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  account_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (account_type IN ('asset', 'liability', 'equity', 'revenue', 'expense')),
  account_subtype VARCHAR(50),
  parent_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  is_system_account BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  description TEXT,
  normal_balance VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (normal_balance IN ('debit', 'credit')),
  level INT DEFAULT 1,
  display_order INT DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_gl_accounts_code ON gl_accounts(account_code);
CREATE INDEX idx_gl_accounts_parent ON gl_accounts(parent_account_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_gl_accounts_type ON gl_accounts(account_type);
CREATE INDEX idx_gl_accounts_active ON gl_accounts(is_active);

-- ── Fiscal Periods ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fiscal_periods (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  period_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  period_number INT NOT NULL,
  fiscal_year INT NOT NULL,
  start_date DATE NOT NULL,
  end_date DATE NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open', 'closing', 'closed', 'locked')),
  closed_by UUID,
  closed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(fiscal_year, period_number)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_fiscal_periods_year ON fiscal_periods(fiscal_year);
CREATE INDEX idx_fiscal_periods_status ON fiscal_periods(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_fiscal_periods_dates ON fiscal_periods(start_date, end_date);

-- ── GL Journal Entries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gl_journal_entries (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  entry_number VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE,
  entry_date DATE NOT NULL,
  fiscal_period_id UUID REFERENCES fiscal_periods(id),
  description TEXT,
  source VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'manual' CHECK (source IN (
    'manual', 'auto_invoice', 'auto_payment', 'auto_grn',
    'auto_credit_note', 'auto_bank_recon'
  )),
  source_document_id UUID,
  status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'posted', 'reversed')),
  posted_by UUID,
  posted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  reversed_by UUID,
  reversed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  reversal_of_id UUID REFERENCES gl_journal_entries(id),
  created_by UUID NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_gl_je_date ON gl_journal_entries(entry_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_gl_je_period ON gl_journal_entries(fiscal_period_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_gl_je_source ON gl_journal_entries(source);
CREATE INDEX idx_gl_je_status ON gl_journal_entries(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_gl_je_number ON gl_journal_entries(entry_number);

-- ── GL Journal Lines ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gl_journal_lines (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  journal_entry_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES gl_journal_entries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  gl_account_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  debit NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0 CHECK (debit >= 0),
  credit NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0 CHECK (credit >= 0),
  description TEXT,
  project_id UUID,
  cost_center_id UUID,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT chk_debit_or_credit CHECK (NOT (debit > 0 AND credit > 0))
);

CREATE INDEX idx_gl_jl_entry ON gl_journal_lines(journal_entry_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_gl_jl_account ON gl_journal_lines(gl_account_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_gl_jl_project ON gl_journal_lines(project_id) WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL;

-- ── GL Account Balances (cache) ─────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gl_account_balances (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  gl_account_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  fiscal_period_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES fiscal_periods(id),
  debit_total NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  credit_total NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  balance NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(gl_account_id, fiscal_period_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_gl_ab_account ON gl_account_balances(gl_account_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_gl_ab_period ON gl_account_balances(fiscal_period_id);

-- ── Triggers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Auto-generate entry_number on INSERT
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION generate_journal_entry_number()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
DECLARE
  entry_year INT;
  next_seq INT;
BEGIN
  entry_year := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NEW.entry_date);
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(
    CAST(SPLIT_PART(entry_number, '-', 3) AS INT)
  ), 0) + 1 INTO next_seq
  FROM gl_journal_entries
  WHERE entry_number LIKE 'JE-' || entry_year || '-%';

  NEW.entry_number := 'JE-' || entry_year || '-' || LPAD(next_seq::TEXT, 5, '0');
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_gl_je_entry_number
  BEFORE INSERT ON gl_journal_entries
  FOR EACH ROW
  WHEN (NEW.entry_number IS NULL)
  EXECUTE FUNCTION generate_journal_entry_number();

-- Enforce balanced entries on post
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_balanced_entry()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
DECLARE
  total_debit NUMERIC(15,2);
  total_credit NUMERIC(15,2);
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status = 'posted' AND (OLD.status IS NULL OR OLD.status = 'draft') THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit), 0), COALESCE(SUM(credit), 0)
    INTO total_debit, total_credit
    FROM gl_journal_lines
    WHERE journal_entry_id = NEW.id;

    IF total_debit != total_credit THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Journal entry is not balanced: debit=% credit=%', total_debit, total_credit;
    END IF;

    IF total_debit = 0 AND total_credit = 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Journal entry has no lines';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_gl_je_balanced
  BEFORE UPDATE ON gl_journal_entries
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_balanced_entry();

-- Update account balances when journal lines change (only for posted entries)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_account_balances()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
DECLARE
  entry_status VARCHAR(20);
  period_id UUID;
BEGIN
  -- Get the entry status and period
  SELECT status, fiscal_period_id INTO entry_status, period_id
  FROM gl_journal_entries
  WHERE id = COALESCE(NEW.journal_entry_id, OLD.journal_entry_id);

  IF entry_status != 'posted' OR period_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
  END IF;

  -- Recalculate balance for the affected account+period
  INSERT INTO gl_account_balances (gl_account_id, fiscal_period_id, debit_total, credit_total, balance)
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NEW.gl_account_id, OLD.gl_account_id),
    period_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(jl.debit), 0),
    COALESCE(SUM(jl.credit), 0),
    COALESCE(SUM(jl.debit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(jl.credit), 0)
  FROM gl_journal_lines jl
  JOIN gl_journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
  WHERE jl.gl_account_id = COALESCE(NEW.gl_account_id, OLD.gl_account_id)
    AND je.fiscal_period_id = period_id
    AND je.status = 'posted'
  ON CONFLICT (gl_account_id, fiscal_period_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    debit_total = EXCLUDED.debit_total,
    credit_total = EXCLUDED.credit_total,
    balance = EXCLUDED.balance,
    updated_at = NOW();

  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_gl_jl_balance_update
  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON gl_journal_lines
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION update_account_balances();

-- Auto-update updated_at
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION accounting_updated_at()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = NOW();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_gl_accounts_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON gl_accounts
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION accounting_updated_at();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_fiscal_periods_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON fiscal_periods
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION accounting_updated_at();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_gl_je_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON gl_journal_entries
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION accounting_updated_at();

-- ── Trial Balance Function ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_trial_balance(p_fiscal_period_id UUID)
RETURNS TABLE (
  account_code VARCHAR(20),
  account_name VARCHAR(100),
  account_type VARCHAR(20),
  normal_balance VARCHAR(10),
  debit_balance NUMERIC(15,2),
  credit_balance NUMERIC(15,2)
) AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    a.account_code,
    a.account_name,
    a.account_type,
    a.normal_balance,
    COALESCE(b.debit_total, 0) AS debit_balance,
    COALESCE(b.credit_total, 0) AS credit_balance
  FROM gl_accounts a
  LEFT JOIN gl_account_balances b ON b.gl_account_id = a.id AND b.fiscal_period_id = p_fiscal_period_id
  WHERE a.is_active = true
    AND (b.debit_total > 0 OR b.credit_total > 0)
  ORDER BY a.account_code;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- =====================================================
-- Migration 000: Users, Sessions, and Auth
-- Standalone accounting app authentication tables
-- =====================================================

-- Updated_at trigger function
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ language 'plpgsql';

-- Users table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

-- Inventory & Products Module (Sprint 2)

-- ── Product Categories ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_categories (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  description TEXT,
  parent_id UUID REFERENCES product_categories(id),
  gl_inventory_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_cogs_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_revenue_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ── Products / Items ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id),
  code TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  category_id UUID REFERENCES product_categories(id),
  category TEXT,
  barcode TEXT,
  unit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'each',
  product_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inventory'
    CHECK (product_type IN ('inventory', 'non_inventory', 'service')),

  -- Pricing
  cost_price NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  selling_price NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  cost_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weighted_average'
    CHECK (cost_method IN ('weighted_average', 'fifo')),
  tax_rate NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 15,

  -- Stock management
  reorder_level NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  reorder_quantity NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  current_stock NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  reserved_stock NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  avg_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,

  -- GL accounts
  gl_inventory_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_cogs_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),
  gl_revenue_account_id UUID REFERENCES gl_accounts(id),

  -- Status
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_by TEXT,
  updated_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),

  UNIQUE(company_id, code)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_company ON products(company_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_category ON products(category_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_code ON products(code);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_barcode ON products(barcode);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_active ON products(is_active);

-- ── Warehouses / Locations ───────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS warehouses (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT NOT NULL,
  address TEXT,
  is_default BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(company_id, code)
);

-- ── Stock Levels (per product per warehouse) ─────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_levels (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  warehouse_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quantity NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  reserved NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  avg_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  last_count_date DATE,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(product_id, warehouse_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_levels_product ON stock_levels(product_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_levels_warehouse ON stock_levels(warehouse_id);

-- ── Stock Movements (audit trail for all stock changes) ──────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_movements (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),
  warehouse_id UUID REFERENCES warehouses(id),
  movement_type TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (movement_type IN (
      'purchase', 'sale', 'adjustment_in', 'adjustment_out',
      'transfer_in', 'transfer_out', 'write_off', 'count',
      'grn', 'return_in', 'return_out'
    )),
  quantity NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL,
  unit_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  total_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  reference_type TEXT,
  reference_id UUID,
  notes TEXT,
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_product ON stock_movements(product_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_type ON stock_movements(movement_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_date ON stock_movements(created_at);

-- ── Stock Adjustments ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_adjustments (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id),
  adjustment_number TEXT NOT NULL,
  adjustment_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),
  warehouse_id UUID REFERENCES warehouses(id),
  adjustment_type TEXT NOT NULL

  quantity NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  unit_cost NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0,

  )),
  reference VARCHAR(255),
  notes TEXT,
  internal_notes TEXT,
  project_id UUID,
  created_by UUID,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(company_id, order_number)
);

# ISAFlow Accounting - Complete Documentation

**Version:** 0.1.0
**Last Updated:** 2026-03-27
**Platform:** Next.js 14.2.18 | TypeScript 5.2.0 | PostgreSQL (Neon Serverless)
**URL:** https://app.isaflow.co.za
**Port:** 3101 (local development)

---

## Table of Contents

1. [Overview](#1-overview)
2. [Technology Stack](#2-technology-stack)
3. [Architecture](#3-architecture)
4. [Authentication & Security](#4-authentication--security)
5. [Module Reference](#5-module-reference)
   - [General Ledger](#51-general-ledger)
   - [Accounts Receivable (Customers)](#52-accounts-receivable-customers)
   - [Accounts Payable (Suppliers)](#53-accounts-payable-suppliers)
   - [Banking & Reconciliation](#54-banking--reconciliation)
   - [Inventory & Items](#55-inventory--items)
   - [VAT & Tax Compliance](#56-vat--tax-compliance)
   - [SARS Compliance](#57-sars-compliance)
   - [Financial Reports](#58-financial-reports)
   - [Payroll](#59-payroll)
   - [Document Capture](#510-document-capture)
   - [Approval Workflows](#511-approval-workflows)
   - [Customer Portal](#512-customer-portal)
   - [Bank Feeds](#513-bank-feeds)
   - [Sage Migration](#514-sage-migration)
6. [Navigation Structure](#6-navigation-structure)
7. [API Reference](#7-api-reference)
8. [Database Schema](#8-database-schema)
9. [Services Reference](#9-services-reference)
10. [Components Reference](#10-components-reference)
11. [Configuration & Deployment](#11-configuration--deployment)
12. [Design Patterns](#12-design-patterns)

---

## 1. Overview

ISAFlow is a standalone, production-grade accounting system built for South African businesses. It provides a full double-entry general ledger, accounts receivable/payable management, bank reconciliation with smart categorisation, payroll with SARS tax compliance, VAT returns, financial reporting, and a customer self-service portal.

### Key Capabilities

- **Double-entry General Ledger** with hierarchical chart of accounts
- **Accounts Receivable** - customer invoicing, receipts, credit notes, statements, write-offs, dunning
- **Accounts Payable** - supplier invoices with 3-way matching, payments, batch payments, returns
- **Bank Reconciliation** - multi-format statement import (FNB, Standard Bank, Nedbank, ABSA, Capitec, OFX, QIF, PDF), auto-matching with confidence scoring, categorisation rules
- **Smart Categorisation** - AI/pattern-based transaction categorisation with 50+ pre-seeded SA merchant patterns
- **VAT Compliance** - standard/zero-rated/exempt/DRC VAT, adjustments, VAT201 returns
- **SARS Integration** - VAT201, EMP201, compliance calendar, submission tracking
- **Payroll** - SA PAYE, UIF, SDL calculations, payslip generation, GL auto-posting
- **Financial Reports** - Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, Trial Balance, Budget vs Actual, Project Profitability, Aging Reports, Audit Trail
- **Multi-currency** support with exchange rate management
- **Cost Centres & Business Units** for dimensional reporting
- **Budgets** with period-level breakdown and variance analysis
- **Recurring Invoices & Journals** with scheduled auto-generation
- **Document Capture** - OCR-based receipt/invoice scanning with data extraction
- **Approval Workflows** - configurable rules by document type and amount threshold
- **Customer Portal** - self-service access to invoices, statements, and payment links
- **Bank Feed Integration** via Stitch.money OAuth
- **Sage Migration** - import chart of accounts, transactions, invoices from Sage
- **PDF Generation** - invoices, credit notes, payslips, statements, reconciliation reports
- **Email Delivery** - invoice emailing with PDF attachments via SMTP

---

## 2. Technology Stack

### Frontend
| Technology | Version | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Next.js | 14.2.18 | React framework (standalone output mode) |
| React | 18.2.0 | UI library |
| TypeScript | 5.2.0 | Type safety |
| Tailwind CSS | 3.4.17 | Utility-first styling with dark mode |
| Recharts | 3.6.0 | Financial charts and dashboards |

#!/bin/bash
# Deploy IsaFlow App to Velocity Server
set -e

DEPLOY_DIR="/home/velo/isaflow"
REPO_DIR="/home/hein/Workspace/Accounting"
SERVICE_NAME="isaflow"

echo "=== Deploying IsaFlow ==="

# 1. Sync files to deploy directory
echo "Syncing files..."
sudo -u velo bash -c "
  mkdir -p $DEPLOY_DIR
  rsync -a --delete \
    --exclude=node_modules \
    --exclude=.next \
    --exclude=.git \
    --exclude=.env.local \
    --exclude=tests \
    --exclude=test-results \
    $REPO_DIR/ $DEPLOY_DIR/
"

# 2. Copy env file if not exists
if [ ! -f "$DEPLOY_DIR/.env.local" ]; then
  echo "Creating .env.local..."
  sudo -u velo bash -c "cp $REPO_DIR/.env.local $DEPLOY_DIR/.env.local"
fi

# 3. Install deps and build
echo "Installing dependencies..."
sudo -u velo bash -c "cd $DEPLOY_DIR && npm install --production"

echo "Building..."
sudo -u velo bash -c "cd $DEPLOY_DIR && npm run build"

# 4. Install systemd service
if [ ! -f /etc/systemd/system/${SERVICE_NAME}.service ]; then
  echo "Installing systemd service..."
  sudo cp $REPO_DIR/scripts/${SERVICE_NAME}.service /etc/systemd/system/
  sudo systemctl daemon-reload
  sudo systemctl enable $SERVICE_NAME
fi

# 5. Install nginx config if not exists
if [ ! -f /etc/nginx/sites-available/app-isaflow ]; then
  echo "Installing nginx config..."
  sudo cp $REPO_DIR/scripts/nginx-app-isaflow /etc/nginx/sites-available/app-isaflow
  sudo ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/app-isaflow /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/app-isaflow
  sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx
fi

# 6. Restart service
echo "Restarting service..."
sudo systemctl restart $SERVICE_NAME

# 7. Check status
sleep 2
sudo systemctl status $SERVICE_NAME --no-pager | head -15

echo ""
echo "=== Deploy complete ==="
echo "App: https://app.isaflow.co.za"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ language 'plpgsql';

-- Users table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  first_name VARCHAR(255),

  last_login TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gl_accounts (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  account_code VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  account_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  account_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (account_type IN ('asset', 'liability', 'equity', 'revenue', 'expense')),

  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  is_system_account BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  description TEXT,
  normal_balance VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (normal_balance IN ('debit', 'credit')),
  level INT DEFAULT 1,
  display_order INT DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

apOverdueRows,
      apCreditorDaysRows,
      invoicesIssuedRows,
      paymentsReceivedRows,
      journalsPostedRows,
    ] = await Promise.all([
      // Current period revenue
      sql`
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.credit - jl.debit), 0) AS total
        FROM gl_journal_lines jl
        JOIN gl_journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
        JOIN gl_accounts ga ON ga.id = jl.gl_account_id
        WHERE ga.account_type = 'revenue' AND je.status = 'posted'
          AND je.entry_date >= ${fromDate} AND je.entry_date <= ${toDate}
      `,
      // Prior period revenue
      sql`
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.credit - jl.debit), 0) AS total
        FROM gl_journal_lines jl
        JOIN gl_journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
        JOIN gl_accounts ga ON ga.id = jl.gl_account_id
        WHERE ga.account_type = 'revenue' AND je.status = 'posted'
          AND je.entry_date >= ${priorFromStr} AND je.entry_date <= ${priorToStr}
      `,
      // Current period expenses
      sql`
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.debit - jl.credit), 0) AS total
        FROM gl_journal_lines jl
        JOIN gl_journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
        JOIN gl_accounts ga ON ga.id = jl.gl_account_id
        WHERE ga.account_type = 'expense' AND je.status = 'posted'
          AND je.entry_date >= ${fromDate} AND je.entry_date <= ${toDate}
      `,
      // Prior period expenses
      sql`
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.debit - jl.credit), 0) AS total
        FROM gl_journal_lines jl
        JOIN gl_journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
        JOIN gl_accounts ga ON ga.id = jl.gl_account_id
        WHERE ga.account_type = 'expense' AND je.status = 'posted'
          AND je.entry_date >= ${priorFromStr} AND je.entry_date <= ${priorToStr}
      `,
      // Current cash position (sum of all bank account balances from transactions)
      sql`
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bt.amount), 0) AS total
        FROM bank_transactions bt
        JOIN gl_accounts ga ON ga.id = bt.bank_account_id
        WHERE ga.account_subtype = 'bank' AND ga.is_active = true
      `,
      // Prior period cash (transactions up to prior period end)
      sql`
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bt.amount), 0) AS total
        FROM bank_transactions bt
        JOIN gl_accounts ga ON ga.id = bt.bank_account_id
        WHERE ga.account_subtype = 'bank' AND ga.is_active = true
          AND bt.transaction_date <= ${priorToStr}
      `,
      // AR total outstanding
      sql`
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount - COALESCE(amount_paid, 0)), 0) AS total
        FROM customer_invoices
        WHERE status IN ('approved', 'sent', 'partially_paid', 'overdue')
          AND (total_amount - COALESCE(amount_paid, 0)) > 0
      `,
      // AR overdue
      sql`
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount - COALESCE(amount_paid, 0)), 0) AS total
        FROM customer_invoices
        WHERE status IN ('approved', 'sent', 'partially_paid', 'overdue')
          AND (total_amount - COALESCE(amount_paid, 0)) > 0
          AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE
      `,
      // Average debtor days
      sql`
        SELECT COALESCE(AVG(
          EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(paid_date, CURRENT_DATE) - invoice_date)) / 86400
        ), 0) AS avg_days
        FROM customer_invoices
        WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'draft')
          AND invoice_date >= ${fromDate}

Now I have a thorough picture of the codebase. Let me compile the complete analysis.

---

## Code Quality Analysis

### Critical Issues

- **[pages/api/accounting/stock-adjustments.ts:15-18]** GET query has no `company_id` filter — all tenants' stock adjustments are exposed to any authenticated company user. Fix: add `WHERE sa.company_id = ${req.companyId}` (companyId is available from `withCompany` middleware as `CompanyApiRequest`).

- **[pages/api/accounting/products.ts:21-28]** All four SELECT branches have no `company_id` filter — products from every tenant are returned to any authenticated user. Fix: cast `req` to `CompanyApiRequest` and append `AND p.company_id = ${companyId}::UUID` to each query.

- **[pages/api/accounting/run-depreciation.ts:26-36]** `FROM assets` with no `company_id` predicate — depreciation runs globally across all companies, not just the requesting company's assets. Fix: add `AND company_id = ${companyId}::UUID` to the WHERE clause.

- **[pages/api/accounting/assets.ts:27-58]** All five GET query branches select `FROM assets` without a `company_id` filter. Fix: add `AND a.company_id = ${companyId}::UUID` to each branch (companyId available from `withCompany`).

- **[src/lib/auth/middleware.ts:267-271]** The optional-auth path (used for contexts where auth is not strictly required) silently swallows any authentication error and proceeds without a user — including unexpected errors like DB timeouts. Fix: distinguish expected "no token" cases from unexpected errors with proper logging; only swallow `no token` errors silently.

---

### Warnings

- **[pages/api/accounting/stock-adjustments.ts:27-28]** `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_adjustments` is not scoped by company, so `ADJ-` numbers are generated from a global count, potentially creating number conflicts between tenants. Fix: scope `COUNT(*)` by company_id.

- **[pages/api/accounting/assets.ts:93, 106]** Two `as any` casts inside business logic (`countResult[0] as any` and `body as any`). The first is because `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` forces the optional chaining, but the type `Row = Record<string, unknown>` should allow direct access with optional chaining; the second (`body.serialNumber`) suggests `AssetInput` is missing the field. Fix: add `serialNumber` to the `AssetInput` interface.

- **[pages/api/accounting/reports-cash-flow.ts:126, 158, 193, 227]** and **[pages/api/accounting/cash-flow-export.ts:132, 164, 199, 233]** — Four empty catch blocks in each file silently coerce failed sub-queries to 0. This masks data errors (e.g., wrong GL account codes). Fix: log a warning with `log.warn(...)` so missing configurations surface in logs.

- **[pages/accounting/bank-transactions/new.tsx:52-78]** Four sequential `.then().then()` chains without a shared error handler. An error in any single chain silently fails (no `.catch()` per chain — only `Promise.allSettled` at the outer level). Fix: already partially mitigated by `allSettled`, but each individual chain should at minimum propagate its rejection into the settled result rather than dropping it.

- **[pages/accounting/assets/new.tsx:55]** and **[pages/accounting/products/new.tsx:27]** — `.catch(() => {})` silently drops reference-data fetch failures with no user feedback. Fix: set a visible error state or at minimum use `/* non-critical — UI handles empty list */` comment for clarity.

- **[src/modules/accounting/services/timeTrackingService.ts:84]** Uses `(sql as any)(text, params)` to call the neon client in parameterized-string mode. Fix: define a proper overload type or use the `neon()` function directly in string-template mode so the escape hatch isn't needed.

- **[pages/api/accounting/handler as any — 151 API files]** Every API route exports `withCompany(withErrorHandler(handler as any))`. The `as any` is necessary because `handler` accepts `AuthenticatedNextApiRequest` but `withErrorHandler` is typed for `NextApiRequest`. Fix: make `withErrorHandler` generic in the same way `withAuth` is (it already accepts `R extends NextApiRequest` — the issue is the wrapper return type mismatches). A single type-level fix in `withErrorHandler` would eliminate 151 `as any` casts.

- **[pages/accounting/company-settings.tsx:345, 353, 367]** Three sequential `catch { /* supplementary */ }` blocks around separate data-fetching hooks in the same `useEffect`. This is fine defensively but means partial load failures (e.g., company documents API is down) are invisible to the user. Fix: add a non-blocking toast or fallback indicator when supplementary data fails.

- **[src/modules/accounting/services/invoicePdfService.ts:277, 549, 584]** `(doc as any).lastAutoTable` — accesses an undocumented jsPDF-AutoTable property. Fix: declare a local interface `interface JsPDFWithAutoTable extends jsPDF { lastAutoTable?: { finalY: number } }` and cast once at the top of the file.

---

### Suggestions

- **[pages/accounting/index.tsx:1554 lines], [src/modules/accounting/services/bankReconciliationService.ts:1159], [src/modules/accounting/services/consolidatedReportingService.ts:1136], [pages/accounting/group/setup.tsx:1063], [pages/accounting/company-settings.tsx:1046]** — Five files exceed 1000 lines (14 files exceed 300 lines). Fix: extract logical sections into child components or sub-services. The 1554-line `pages/accounting/index.tsx` in particular bundles five tabs' worth of state and JSX; each tab panel should be its own lazy-loaded component.

- **[pages/api/accounting/assets.ts:27-57]** Five nearly-identical SQL branches differing only in their WHERE clause. Fix: build the WHERE clause dynamically (similar to how `timeTrackingService.ts` builds `conditions[]`).

- **[pages/api/accounting/bank-transactions/new.tsx:52-78], [pages/accounting/bank-transactions/index.tsx:97-137]** Both pages load the same four reference-data endpoints (`bank-accounts`, `chart-of-accounts`, `suppliers`, `clients`) independently with duplicated chain logic. Fix: extract a `useReferenceData()` hook.

- **[pages/api/accounting/stock-adjustments.ts:28]** `as any` on `countRes[0]` is unnecessary since `Row = Record<string, unknown>` already allows optional-chained property access. Fix: use `(countRes[0]?.cnt as number | undefined) ?? 0`.

- **[src/lib/logger.ts:174, 185]** Uses `(process as any).__appLogs` to store logs on the process object — a non-standard side-channel. Fix: use a proper module-level singleton array or a dedicated in-memory store exported from the logger module.

- **[pages/api/accounting/approval-requests.ts:30]** `documentType as any` cast when calling a service function — suggests the service's accepted union type is narrower than the set of strings coming from the API body. Fix: add a runtime check (`if (!VALID_DOC_TYPES.includes(documentType)) return badRequest(...)`) before the cast.

- **[No Zod / schema validation on request bodies]** API routes receiving complex mutations (batch-payments, bank-transactions-action, credit-notes, supplier-payments-action, etc.) parse `req.body` directly with only bespoke `validateXxx()` functions or no validation at all. Fix: adopt Zod schemas (already used in test files) consistently at the API boundary for all mutation routes.

---

### Score: 5.5/10

### Summary

The codebase has a solid structural foundation — consistent auth middleware, a proper error-handler wrapper, and service-layer validation — but three multi-tenant data-isolation bugs (products, assets, stock-adjustments GET queries missing `company_id` filters) represent serious security/correctness flaws that must be fixed before production use. Beyond those critical issues, widespread `handler as any` casts (151 files) and numerous files exceeding 500–1500 lines signal that type-system infrastructure and component decomposition need targeted investment to keep the codebase maintainable as it grows.

The `test:e2e` script in `package.json` calls `playwright test` with no `--config` flag, so it picks up `playwright.config.ts` — the one *without* authentication. All tests that require login will silently fail or get 307 redirects instead of 200s.
  Fix: Remove `playwright.config.ts` (or rename it), and update `package.json` to `"test:e2e": "playwright test --config playwright-test.config.ts"`.

- **[vitest.config.ts:9-12] Coverage provider `v8` is configured but `@vitest/coverage-v8` is not installed.**
  Running `bun run test:unit -- --coverage` will throw a hard error: `Error: @vitest/coverage-v8 is not installed`. The package is absent from both `dependencies` and `devDependencies`.
  Fix: `bun add -D @vitest/coverage-v8`.

- **[.env.example:1-19] Seven production-required environment variables are completely absent from `.env.example`.**
  `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASS`, `SMTP_FROM`, `STITCH_CLIENT_ID`, `STITCH_CLIENT_SECRET`, `STITCH_REDIRECT_URI`, and `VF_STORAGE_URL` are all referenced in source code but are not documented in `.env.example`. A new developer or deployment engineer will discover missing vars only at runtime.
  Fix: Add all nine variables to `.env.example` with placeholder values and comments.

- **[middleware.ts:config] Auth middleware matcher only covers `/accounting/:path*` — `/payroll/*` and `/portal/*` are unprotected at the edge.**
  The `matcher` export is `['/', '/accounting/:path*', '/onboarding/:path*']`. The payroll module (`/payroll/employees`, `/payroll/runs`) and bank feeds (`/accounting/bank-feeds`) rely on route-level checks only, meaning middleware never enforces auth for `/payroll`.
  Fix: Add `/payroll/:path*` and `/portal/:path*` (if it requires auth) to the matcher array.

---

### Warnings

- **[scripts/deploy.sh:3] Deploy script runs no tests, no lint, and no type-check before deploying to production.**
  The script goes straight from `rsync` to `npm install --production` to `npm run build`. A broken commit can be deployed with no automated gate.
  Fix: Add `npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test:unit` before the rsync step.

- **[scripts/deploy.sh:20] Deploy script uses `npm` rather than `bun`, inconsistent with the declared package manager.**
  The repo ships a `bun.lock` and sets `bun` as the implied package manager, but the deploy script calls `npm install --production` and `npm run build`. This risks lock-file drift and different resolved versions in production.
  Fix: Replace `npm install --production` with `bun install --production` and `npm run build` with `bun run build`.

- **[vitest.config.ts:9-12] No coverage thresholds configured — coverage can regress silently.**
  The coverage block reports `text` and `lcov` but has no `thresholds` key. CI (when it exists) or local runs will never fail on coverage regression.
  Fix: Add `thresholds: { lines: 70, functions: 70, branches: 60 }` as a starting baseline.

- **[tests/ — coverage gap] 47 accounting services and 1 payroll service have exactly 3 unit test files covering only 2 services (assetService, inventoryService).**
  Modules like `bankReconciliationService`, `payrollService` (PAYE/UIF/SDL tax calculations — legally critical), `vatAdjustmentService`, `journalEntryService`, and `budgetService` have zero unit coverage. The E2E tests only confirm HTTP 200s and UI rendering, not calculation correctness.
  Fix: Prioritise unit tests for `payrollService` (tax calculations) and `bankReconciliationService` (auto-match confidence scoring) as high-risk financial logic.

- **[tests/e2e/auth.setup.ts:10-11] Hardcoded test credentials `admin@accounting.local / admin123` in E2E setup.**
  These are committed in plain text and assume the local database has been seeded with this exact user. A fresh dev environment will have no such user and E2E will fail immediately with no clear error.
  Fix: Move credentials to `.env.example` as `E2E_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `E2E_ADMIN_PASSWORD` and read them via `process.env` in `auth.setup.ts`. Add a seed script comment explaining the prerequisite.

- **[.eslintrc.json:22-23] `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` and `no-console` are set to `warn` instead of `error`.**
  There are already 64 `eslint-disable` suppressions in `src/`. Warnings are routinely ignored in CI-less workflows — these rules effectively do nothing.
  Fix: Promote both to `"error"` and work through the existing suppressions; or at minimum add `--max-warnings 0` to the `lint` script.

- **[No .github/workflows/] Zero CI/CD pipeline exists.**
  There are no GitHub Actions (or any other CI) workflows. Every quality gate (lint, type-check, tests) is 100% manual and optional.
  Fix: Add a `.github/workflows/ci.yml` that runs `bun run lint`, `bun run type-check`, and `bun run test:unit` on every push and pull request.

---

### Suggestions

- **[package.json:9] The `lint` script does not include `--max-warnings 0`.**
  With warnings as the severity for `no-explicit-any` and `no-unused-vars`, the lint step passes even with outstanding issues.
  Fix: `"lint": "eslint src pages --ext ts,tsx --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0"`.

- **[package.json:11] No `test:coverage` script is defined.**
  Developers have to know to type `vitest run --coverage` manually.
  Fix: Add `"test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage"` to `scripts`.

- **[src/lib/logger.ts:125-143] The logger stores entries in an in-memory array (`window.__appLogs` / `process.__appLogs`) that is invisible in production.**
  In production (where `enableConsole` is false), no log is written anywhere observable — not stdout, not a file, not an external service. Errors in production are completely silent.
  Fix: In the Node.js path, write at minimum to `process.stdout` / `process.stderr` for the `warn` and `error` levels, or integrate a lightweight structured logger like `pino` that outputs NDJSON for log aggregation.

- **[package.json:6] `next dev` has no `--turbo` flag.**
  Next.js 14 supports Turbopack for significantly faster HMR. It is not enabled.
  Fix: `"dev": "next dev --turbo"` (verify compatibility with any custom webpack config first, then remove the webpack block in `next.config.js` if Turbopack is adopted fully).

  `DOCUMENTATION.md` is comprehensive (1178 lines) but has no quick-start section. A new contributor must read through architecture documentation to discover the first `bun install && bun run dev` commands. There is also no `CLAUDE.md` for AI-assisted development context.
  Fix: Add a `README.md` with a 10-line quick-start (prerequisites, `bun install`, seed database, `bun run dev`). Optionally create a `CLAUDE.md` summarising architecture decisions for AI tooling.

  E2E tests against a local dev server with no retry budget will produce flaky results for any timing-sensitive interaction.
  Fix: Set `retries: 2` for CI and leave `retries: 0` only for local watch mode.

- **[tsconfig.json:21-29] `paths` declares both `@/*` and redundant sub-aliases (`@/lib/*`, `@/components/*`, etc.).**
  Since `@/*` already resolves to `./src/*`, the specific path aliases are redundant and can cause confusion when paths resolve through two mechanisms.
  Fix: Remove the sub-aliases and rely solely on `@/*`.

---

ISAFlow has a strong foundation — strict TypeScript, well-structured service layer, good error handler patterns, and meaningful unit tests for the modules that *are* tested. However, the absence of CI/CD, a broken E2E test configuration (wrong playwright config selected by default, missing auth session), nine undocumented environment variables, and zero unit test coverage across 45+ financial calculation services (including legally sensitive payroll tax) represent significant DX and correctness risk that would slow onboarding and mask regressions in production.

## Performance Analysis

### Critical Issues

**[src/modules/accounting/services/kpiService.ts:56, 250, 289, 326, 379, 406] — Missing company_id scoping on all KPI queries.**
Every function in `kpiService.ts` accepts a `_companyId` parameter (underscore-prefixed, intentionally unused) but none of the SQL queries filter by `company_id`. Queries against `customer_invoices`, `supplier_invoices`, `bank_transactions`, `gl_journal_entries`, `gl_journal_lines`, and `gl_accounts` aggregate data across **all companies**. This is a data-isolation regression and will produce incorrect dashboard numbers in any multi-tenant production environment, and will become dramatically slower as total row counts grow.
Fix: Add `AND je.company_id = ${companyId}::UUID` (or equivalent) to every query in the file, passing the real `companyId` argument through.

**[pages/accounting/reports/general-ledger.tsx:83] — Up to 20 parallel API calls on every report load.**
The GL report page fires `Promise.all(top20.map(...))` which makes up to 20 simultaneous HTTP requests to `/api/accounting/reports-account-transactions`, each hitting the database. With Neon's serverless driver this can saturate the connection pool and introduces significant overhead per cold connection.
Fix: Create a single `/api/accounting/reports/general-ledger` endpoint that accepts an array of account codes and returns all data in one SQL query (GROUP BY account), or batch into 3–4 requests maximum.

**[pages/accounting/statement-run/index.tsx:87-110] — Sequential per-customer HTTP + PDF requests in a loop.**
The statement generation loop calls `await apiFetch(...)` for each selected customer one at a time inside a `for...of` loop. For a 50-customer batch this creates a 50-deep sequential waterfall of network + DB + PDF generation calls.
Fix: Batch the detail fetches with `Promise.all` (respecting a concurrency limit), or create a bulk `/api/accounting/customer-statement-batch` endpoint.

---

### Warnings

**[pages/accounting/index.tsx:37-39] — Recharts imported statically on the main accounting dashboard.**
`recharts` (~350 KB minified) is imported at the top of `pages/accounting/index.tsx` with a bare static import, adding it to the initial JS bundle for every visitor who lands on this page, even before any chart is visible. Compare with `cash-flow-forecast.tsx` which correctly uses `dynamic()` per-component.
Fix: Apply the same `dynamic(() => import('recharts').then(m => m.LineChart), { ssr: false })` pattern used in `cash-flow-forecast.tsx`. All six recharts components imported on line 37–39 should be lazily loaded.

**[pages/api/accounting/customers.ts:43, pages/api/accounting/suppliers-list.ts:46] — Hard-coded `LIMIT 200` with no pagination or total count returned.**
The customers and suppliers list endpoints cap results at 200 rows and return no `total` count for cursor/page navigation. For businesses with >200 records the UI silently truncates. There is also no offset-based pagination support.
Fix: Add `limit`/`offset` query params, return `{ items, total }`, and implement a `COUNT(*) OVER()` window or a separate `SELECT COUNT(*)` query.

**[pages/api/accounting/assets.ts:24-57] — Duplicated query branches with hard-coded `LIMIT 200`, no pagination.**
The assets API has five branches of nearly identical SQL differing only in WHERE clauses, all capped at 200. No pagination params are accepted.
Fix: Consolidate into parameterised dynamic SQL and add `limit`/`offset` support.

**[pages/api/accounting/customer-invoices-list.ts:59] — `total: invoices.length` reports page size, not true total.**
The endpoint paginates correctly with `LIMIT/OFFSET` but then returns `total: invoices.length` (the slice count, max 50) instead of a `COUNT(*)` of the full result set. The UI cannot render correct page counts.
Fix: Add a `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_invoices WHERE ...` using the same filters, return it as `total`.

**[pages/accounting/index.tsx:295, 318, 417, 461] — Inline `contentStyle` objects on recharts `<Tooltip>` cause re-renders on every chart update.**
Each `<Tooltip contentStyle={{ ... }}>` creates a new object reference on each render, which recharts compares by reference and treats as changed, potentially triggering internal re-renders on tooltip hover.
Fix: Extract the `contentStyle` object to a module-level constant (e.g. `const TOOLTIP_STYLE = { backgroundColor: 'var(--ff-bg-secondary)', ... }`).

**[pages/accounting/index.tsx:296, 319, 418, 462] — Inline arrow functions as recharts `formatter` prop.**
`formatter={(value) => [fmtCurrency(Number(value)), '']}` creates a new function reference on every render, same re-render risk as the contentStyle issue above.
Fix: Extract to a `useCallback` or module-level constant formatter.

**[src/modules/accounting/services/kpiService.ts:250-285, 289-321] — `getRevenueChart` and `getCashFlowChart` do not filter by `company_id` at all.**

Fix: Add `AND je.company_id = ${companyId}::UUID` / `AND ga.company_id = ${companyId}::UUID`.

`DebtorDetailPanel` fires a separate `apiFetch('/api/accounting/debtors-manager?customerId=...')` each time a row is expanded. If users expand many rows, each expansion triggers a new DB round-trip with no caching.

## 1. Overview

ISAFlow is a standalone, production-grade accounting system built for South African businesses. It provides a full double-entry general ledger, accounts receivable/payable management, bank reconciliation with smart categorisation, payroll with SARS tax compliance, VAT returns, financial reporting, and a customer self-service portal.

### Key Capabilities

- **Double-entry General Ledger** with hierarchical chart of accounts
- **Accounts Receivable** - customer invoicing, receipts, credit notes, statements, write-offs, dunning
- **Accounts Payable** - supplier invoices with 3-way matching, payments, batch payments, returns
- **Bank Reconciliation** - multi-format statement import (FNB, Standard Bank, Nedbank, ABSA, Capitec, OFX, QIF, PDF), auto-matching with confidence scoring, categorisation rules
- **Smart Categorisation** - AI/pattern-based transaction categorisation with 50+ pre-seeded SA merchant patterns
- **VAT Compliance** - standard/zero-rated/exempt/DRC VAT, adjustments, VAT201 returns
- **SARS Integration** - VAT201, EMP201, compliance calendar, submission tracking
- **Payroll** - SA PAYE, UIF, SDL calculations, payslip generation, GL auto-posting
- **Financial Reports** - Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, Trial Balance, Budget vs Actual, Project Profitability, Aging Reports, Audit Trail
- **Multi-currency** support with exchange rate management
- **Cost Centres & Business Units** for dimensional reporting
- **Budgets** with period-level breakdown and variance analysis
- **Recurring Invoices & Journals** with scheduled auto-generation
- **Document Capture** - OCR-based receipt/invoice scanning with data extraction
- **Approval Workflows** - configurable rules by document type and amount threshold
- **Customer Portal** - self-service access to invoices, statements, and payment links
- **Bank Feed Integration** via Stitch.money OAuth
- **Sage Migration** - import chart of accounts, transactions, invoices from Sage
- **PDF Generation** - invoices, credit notes, payslips, statements, reconciliation reports
- **Email Delivery** - invoice emailing with PDF attachments via SMTP

## Architecture Analysis

### Critical Issues

- **[`/middleware.ts:27`] All `/api/*` routes are globally bypassed by Edge Middleware.** The matcher (`['/', '/accounting/:path*', '/onboarding/:path*']`) covers only page routes, and the inline bypass `pathname.startsWith('/api/')` skips auth checks at the edge for every API route. This is acceptable *only* because each route uses `withAuth`/`withCompany` — but it creates a single point of failure: any route that accidentally omits those wrappers is immediately public. Fix: Audit the matcher to include `/api/*` at the edge, or add a lint rule enforcing `withCompany` on every API handler.

- **[`/pages/api/accounting/items.ts:43–77`] Dead code / cartesian-explosion query builder.** The file builds `conditions[]` and `params[]` arrays (lines 43–77) but then abandons them entirely and falls into a massive if/else tree of ~16 tagged-template permutations duplicating the same `SELECT` statement. `whereClause` is constructed but never used. This adds ~200 lines of unmaintainable dead code and will break silently if a new filter is added to only one branch. Fix: Use a single parameterised query builder utility or migrate to a query builder (e.g. Kysely).

- **[`/pages/api/payroll/*.ts`] Payroll module is not company-scoped.** All 5 payroll API routes wrap with `withAuth` instead of `withCompany`. The payroll service (`payrollService.ts`) contains no `company_id` filter in its SQL queries. In a multi-tenant app this means any authenticated user can read/write all employees and payroll runs across all tenants. Fix: Add `companyId` to `withCompany` wrapper and propagate `company_id` through all payroll DB queries.

- **[`/pages/api/portal/invoices.ts:20–38`] Portal session cookie contains unsigned plain JSON — trivially forgeable.** The `portal_session` cookie is read, URL-decoded, and `JSON.parse`d with no signature verification. Any client can craft `{"clientId":"any-uuid"}` and access another client's invoices. Fix: Sign the session with `jose` (already a project dependency) and verify the signature before trusting the `clientId`.

- **[`/pages/portal/index.tsx:63`] Portal auth flow broken / split-brain.** `portal/auth.ts` returns user data in the response body but never sets a `portal_session` cookie. The frontend stores auth state in `localStorage`. Meanwhile `portal/invoices.ts` checks for a `portal_session` **cookie** that is never set. The two halves of portal auth are mismatched. Fix: Either set an httpOnly signed cookie in `portal/auth.ts` and rely on it, or drop the cookie check in `portal/invoices.ts` and accept the `clientId` from the authenticated session stored server-side.

---

### Warnings

- **[`/pages/api/accounting/` — reports routing]** Inconsistent two-tier routing: 12 report routes are flat files (`reports-income-statement.ts`, `reports-cash-flow.ts` etc. → URL `/api/accounting/reports-income-statement`) while 8 are in a subdirectory (`reports/sales-by-item.ts` → URL `/api/accounting/reports/sales-by-item`). There is no structural reason for the split. Fix: Migrate all report routes into `pages/api/accounting/reports/` for consistent URL hierarchy.

tool_input.content:
# AutoResearch Report: ISAFlow Accounting

**Date:** 2026-03-28
**Files Analyzed:** 646 (341 pages, 117 src, 188 API routes)
**Issues Found:** 12 critical, 24 warnings, 22 suggestions
**Overall Score: 5/10**

## Executive Summary

ISAFlow has a solid architectural foundation — strict TypeScript, consistent auth middleware, proper service-layer separation, and comprehensive feature coverage matching Sage Accounting. However, the audit uncovered **critical multi-tenant data isolation bugs** across 5 modules (products, assets, stock-adjustments, KPI dashboard, payroll) where queries lack `company_id` filters, exposing all tenants' data. The portal authentication is fundamentally broken (session cookie never set), and real database credentials are committed to the repository. These must be fixed before any production use with real customer data.

---

## Critical Issues (Fix Now)

### 1. MULTI-TENANT DATA LEAKS (5 modules)
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `pages/api/accounting/products.ts:21-28` | All SELECT queries missing `company_id` filter — returns all tenants' products |
| `pages/api/accounting/assets.ts:27-58` | All 5 GET query branches missing `company_id` filter |
| `pages/api/accounting/stock-adjustments.ts:15-18` | GET query has no `company_id` filter |
| `pages/api/accounting/run-depreciation.ts:26-36` | Depreciation runs globally across all companies |
| `src/modules/accounting/services/kpiService.ts:56-406` | ALL KPI queries ignore `_companyId` param — dashboard shows cross-tenant data |
| `pages/api/payroll/*.ts` (5 files) | All payroll routes use `withAuth` not `withCompany` — no tenant isolation |

**Impact:** Any authenticated user can see/modify other companies' data.

### 2. PORTAL AUTH BROKEN
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `pages/api/portal/auth.ts` | Returns user data in response body but **never sets** `portal_session` cookie |
| `pages/api/portal/invoices.ts:20-38` | Checks for `portal_session` cookie that is never set — always fails |
| `pages/portal/index.tsx:63` | Stores auth in `localStorage` (XSS-readable) instead of httpOnly cookie |
| `pages/api/portal/invoices.ts` | Cookie contains unsigned plain JSON — trivially forgeable with `{"clientId":"any-uuid"}` |

### 3. COMMITTED SECRETS
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `.env.local:3` | Real Neon DB password (`npg_TDuKN9ao1sZB`) committed |
| `.env.local:2` | Weak JWT secret (`accounting-app-jwt-secret-change-in-production`) |
| `scripts/run-migrations.mjs:64-70` | Hardcoded admin password `admin123` in migration seed |

### 4. PASSWORDS LOGGED IN PLAINTEXT
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `src/lib/api-error-handler.ts:62` | All non-GET request bodies logged including passwords from `/api/auth/login` |

### 5. MIDDLEWARE AUTH BYPASS
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `middleware.ts:27` | All `/api/*` routes globally bypassed by Edge Middleware — any route missing `withAuth` is fully public |
| `middleware.ts:config` | `/payroll/*` and `/portal/*` not in matcher — no edge auth enforcement |

### 6. MIGRATION SYSTEM BROKEN
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `scripts/run-migrations.mjs:48-57` | No migration-tracking table — re-runs every SQL file; 50 `CREATE INDEX` without `IF NOT EXISTS` will error |
| `scripts/run-migrations.mjs` | Migrations 245-248 (company settings, customer fields, sales orders, bank fields) are **absent from runner array** |

---

## Warnings (Fix Soon)

### Security
1. **No rate limiting** on `/api/auth/login` and `/api/auth/register` — brute-force vulnerable
2. **No CSP or HSTS headers** in `next.config.js` — no XSS defense for financial app
3. **JWT/cookie expiry mismatch** — JWT expires 24h but cookie maxAge is 30 days
4. **Cloudflare SSL "Flexible"** — origin traffic unencrypted (`scripts/nginx-app-isaflow`)
5. **User enumeration** — register returns distinct error for existing emails
6. **CSV injection** — export helpers don't strip formula characters (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`)
7. **PayFast HMAC logged** — expected signature values logged on mismatch

### Performance
8. **20 parallel API calls** on GL report load (`pages/accounting/reports/general-ledger.tsx:83`)
9. **Sequential statement-run** — per-customer waterfall, no batching (`pages/accounting/statement-run/index.tsx:87-110`)
10. **Recharts static import** — ~350KB on main dashboard, should be lazy (`pages/accounting/index.tsx:37`)
11. **No pagination** on customers/suppliers API — hard `LIMIT 200` truncates silently
12. **customer-invoices-list** returns `total: invoices.length` (page size) not true total

### Code Quality
13. **151 API files** use `handler as any` cast — fixable with one type-level change in `withErrorHandler`
14. **5 files over 1000 lines** — `index.tsx` (1554), `bankReconciliationService.ts` (1159), `consolidatedReportingService.ts` (1136), `group/setup.tsx` (1063), `company-settings.tsx` (1046)
15. **8 empty catch blocks** in cash-flow reports silently mask data errors
16. **Dead code** in `items.ts` — builds conditions/params arrays then ignores them for 16-branch if/else tree

### Architecture
17. **Inconsistent report routing** — 12 flat files vs 8 in subdirectory
18. **51 inline currency formatters** — shared `formatCurrency` utility exists but unused in half the files
19. **Payroll pages use `fetch()`** not `apiFetch()` — won't send company headers when scoped
20. **Duplicate pages** — `customer-age-analysis.tsx` duplicates `ar-aging/index.tsx`

### DX
21. **No CI/CD pipeline** — zero GitHub Actions workflows
22. **Broken Playwright config** — default config points to wrong port, no auth setup
23. **Missing coverage provider** — `@vitest/coverage-v8` not installed
24. **9 env vars undocumented** in `.env.example` (SMTP, Stitch, VF_STORAGE)

---

## Suggestions (Improve Over Time)

1. Split 1554-line dashboard into lazy-loaded tab components
2. Add `recharts` to `optimizePackageImports` in next.config.js
3. Implement `Cache-Control` headers on read-only GET routes
4. Add composite index `gl_journal_lines(journal_entry_id, gl_account_id)`
5. Cache company settings during batch PDF generation
6. Extract `useReferenceData()` hook for bank-transactions pages
7. Add Zod schema validation on all mutation API routes
8. Create `createHandler()` factory to standardize middleware composition
9. Remove unused deps: `sonner`, `uuid`, `zod` (unused), `papaparse`
10. Add `README.md` with quick-start guide
11. Promote `no-explicit-any` and `no-console` from warn to error
12. Add `--turbo` flag to `next dev` for faster HMR
13. Sign `decodeToken()` with warning comment about auth decisions
14. Implement proper refresh-token flow instead of 24h JWT + 30d cookie
15. Add timing-safe comparison guard to portal login (matches main login)
16. Write unit tests for payroll tax calculations (legally critical)
17. Write unit tests for bank reconciliation auto-matching
18. Use `bun install` in deploy.sh instead of `npm install`
19. Set Playwright retries to 2 for CI stability
20. Add coverage thresholds to vitest config
21. Remove redundant tsconfig path sub-aliases
22. Move `vfStorageAdapter.ts` into proper module boundary

---

## Dimension Scores

| Dimension | Score | Key Finding |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| Architecture | 5/10 | Solid foundation but portal auth broken, payroll unscoped, 1500+ line files |
| Code Quality | 5.5/10 | 3 multi-tenant data leaks, 151 `as any` casts, dead code in items.ts |
| Performance | 5/10 | KPI ignores company_id, 20-call GL waterfall, no pagination on core lists |
| Security | 5/10 | Committed credentials, broken portal session, no rate limiting, passwords logged |
| Developer Experience | 5.5/10 | No CI/CD, broken E2E config, 45+ services with zero test coverage |
| Dependencies & Infra | 4/10 | Committed DB password, migration runner broken, unencrypted origin traffic |

---

## Quick Wins (< 30 min each)

- [ ] Add `company_id` filter to products, assets, stock-adjustments, run-depreciation queries
- [ ] Add `_companyId` usage to all kpiService queries (replace underscore prefix)
- [ ] Exclude `password` field from api-error-handler body logging
- [ ] Add migrations 245-248 to the runner array
- [ ] Add `/payroll/:path*` to middleware matcher
- [ ] Rotate Neon DB credentials and JWT secret
- [ ] Install `@vitest/coverage-v8`
- [ ] Fix Playwright config: update package.json to use `--config playwright-test.config.ts`
- [ ] Add `Strict-Transport-Security` header to next.config.js

## Recommended Roadmap

### Week 1: Security & Data Isolation (Critical)
1. Fix all 6 multi-tenant data leak modules
2. Fix portal auth (set signed httpOnly cookie)
3. Rotate committed credentials
4. Add rate limiting to auth endpoints
5. Stop logging passwords
6. Add CSP + HSTS headers

### Week 2-3: Infrastructure & Quality
7. Fix migration runner (tracking table + add missing files)
8. Set up GitHub Actions CI (lint, type-check, unit tests)
9. Fix Playwright E2E config
10. Add pagination to customers/suppliers/assets APIs
11. Split monolith files (dashboard, bank recon service)
12. Lazy-load recharts on dashboard

### Week 4+: Ongoing
13. Write unit tests for payroll tax calculations
14. Write unit tests for bank reconciliation
15. Standardize API route patterns
16. Add Zod validation to mutation routes
17. Implement refresh-token flow
18. Switch Cloudflare to Full (Strict) SSL

# AutoResearch Report: ISAFlow Accounting

**Date:** 2026-03-28
**Files Analyzed:** 646 (341 pages, 117 src, 188 API routes)
**Issues Found:** 12 critical, 24 warnings, 22 suggestions
**Overall Score: 5/10**

## Executive Summary

ISAFlow has a solid architectural foundation — strict TypeScript, consistent auth middleware, proper service-layer separation, and comprehensive feature coverage matching Sage Accounting. However, the audit uncovered **critical multi-tenant data isolation bugs** across 5 modules (products, assets, stock-adjustments, KPI dashboard, payroll) where queries lack `company_id` filters, exposing all tenants' data. The portal authentication is fundamentally broken (session cookie never set), and real database credentials are committed to the repository. These must be fixed before any production use with real customer data.

---

## Critical Issues (Fix Now)

### 1. MULTI-TENANT DATA LEAKS (5 modules)
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `pages/api/accounting/products.ts:21-28` | All SELECT queries missing `company_id` filter — returns all tenants' products |
| `pages/api/accounting/assets.ts:27-58` | All 5 GET query branches missing `company_id` filter |
| `pages/api/accounting/stock-adjustments.ts:15-18` | GET query has no `company_id` filter |
| `pages/api/accounting/run-depreciation.ts:26-36` | Depreciation runs globally across all companies |
| `src/modules/accounting/services/kpiService.ts:56-406` | ALL KPI queries ignore `_companyId` param — dashboard shows cross-tenant data |
| `pages/api/payroll/*.ts` (5 files) | All payroll routes use `withAuth` not `withCompany` — no tenant isolation |

**Impact:** Any authenticated user can see/modify other companies' data.

### 2. PORTAL AUTH BROKEN
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `pages/api/portal/auth.ts` | Returns user data in response body but **never sets** `portal_session` cookie |
| `pages/api/portal/invoices.ts:20-38` | Checks for `portal_session` cookie that is never set — always fails |
| `pages/portal/index.tsx:63` | Stores auth in `localStorage` (XSS-readable) instead of httpOnly cookie |
| `pages/api/portal/invoices.ts` | Cookie contains unsigned plain JSON — trivially forgeable with `{"clientId":"any-uuid"}` |

### 3. COMMITTED SECRETS
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `.env.local:3` | Real Neon DB password (`npg_TDuKN9ao1sZB`) committed |
| `.env.local:2` | Weak JWT secret (`accounting-app-jwt-secret-change-in-production`) |
| `scripts/run-migrations.mjs:64-70` | Hardcoded admin password `admin123` in migration seed |

### 4. PASSWORDS LOGGED IN PLAINTEXT
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `src/lib/api-error-handler.ts:62` | All non-GET request bodies logged including passwords from `/api/auth/login` |

### 5. MIDDLEWARE AUTH BYPASS
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `middleware.ts:27` | All `/api/*` routes globally bypassed by Edge Middleware — any route missing `withAuth` is fully public |
| `middleware.ts:config` | `/payroll/*` and `/portal/*` not in matcher — no edge auth enforcement |

### 6. MIGRATION SYSTEM BROKEN
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `scripts/run-migrations.mjs:48-57` | No migration-tracking table — re-runs every SQL file; 50 `CREATE INDEX` without `IF NOT EXISTS` will error |
| `scripts/run-migrations.mjs` | Migrations 245-248 (company settings, customer fields, sales orders, bank fields) are **absent from runner array** |

---

## Warnings (Fix Soon)

### Security
1. **No rate limiting** on `/api/auth/login` and `/api/auth/register` — brute-force vulnerable
2. **No CSP or HSTS headers** in `next.config.js` — no XSS defense for financial app
3. **JWT/cookie expiry mismatch** — JWT expires 24h but cookie maxAge is 30 days
4. **Cloudflare SSL "Flexible"** — origin traffic unencrypted (`scripts/nginx-app-isaflow`)
5. **User enumeration** — register returns distinct error for existing emails
6. **CSV injection** — export helpers don't strip formula characters (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`)
7. **PayFast HMAC logged** — expected signature values logged on mismatch

### Performance
8. **20 parallel API calls** on GL report load (`pages/accounting/reports/general-ledger.tsx:83`)
9. **Sequential statement-run** — per-customer waterfall, no batching (`pages/accounting/statement-run/index.tsx:87-110`)
10. **Recharts static import** — ~350KB on main dashboard, should be lazy (`pages/accounting/index.tsx:37`)
11. **No pagination** on customers/suppliers API — hard `LIMIT 200` truncates silently
12. **customer-invoices-list** returns `total: invoices.length` (page size) not true total

### Code Quality
13. **151 API files** use `handler as any` cast — fixable with one type-level change in `withErrorHandler`
14. **5 files over 1000 lines** — `index.tsx` (1554), `bankReconciliationService.ts` (1159), `consolidatedReportingService.ts` (1136), `group/setup.tsx` (1063), `company-settings.tsx` (1046)
15. **8 empty catch blocks** in cash-flow reports silently mask data errors
16. **Dead code** in `items.ts` — builds conditions/params arrays then ignores them for 16-branch if/else tree

### Architecture
17. **Inconsistent report routing** — 12 flat files vs 8 in subdirectory
18. **51 inline currency formatters** — shared `formatCurrency` utility exists but unused in half the files
19. **Payroll pages use `fetch()`** not `apiFetch()` — won't send company headers when scoped
20. **Duplicate pages** — `customer-age-analysis.tsx` duplicates `ar-aging/index.tsx`

### DX
21. **No CI/CD pipeline** — zero GitHub Actions workflows
22. **Broken Playwright config** — default config points to wrong port, no auth setup
23. **Missing coverage provider** — `@vitest/coverage-v8` not installed
24. **9 env vars undocumented** in `.env.example` (SMTP, Stitch, VF_STORAGE)

---

## Suggestions (Improve Over Time)

1. Split 1554-line dashboard into lazy-loaded tab components
2. Add `recharts` to `optimizePackageImports` in next.config.js
3. Implement `Cache-Control` headers on read-only GET routes
4. Add composite index `gl_journal_lines(journal_entry_id, gl_account_id)`
5. Cache company settings during batch PDF generation
6. Extract `useReferenceData()` hook for bank-transactions pages
7. Add Zod schema validation on all mutation API routes
8. Create `createHandler()` factory to standardize middleware composition
9. Remove unused deps: `sonner`, `uuid`, `zod` (unused), `papaparse`
10. Add `README.md` with quick-start guide
11. Promote `no-explicit-any` and `no-console` from warn to error
12. Add `--turbo` flag to `next dev` for faster HMR
13. Sign `decodeToken()` with warning comment about auth decisions
14. Implement proper refresh-token flow instead of 24h JWT + 30d cookie
15. Add timing-safe comparison guard to portal login (matches main login)
16. Write unit tests for payroll tax calculations (legally critical)
17. Write unit tests for bank reconciliation auto-matching
18. Use `bun install` in deploy.sh instead of `npm install`
19. Set Playwright retries to 2 for CI stability
20. Add coverage thresholds to vitest config
21. Remove redundant tsconfig path sub-aliases
22. Move `vfStorageAdapter.ts` into proper module boundary

---

## Dimension Scores

| Dimension | Score | Key Finding |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| Architecture | 5/10 | Solid foundation but portal auth broken, payroll unscoped, 1500+ line files |
| Code Quality | 5.5/10 | 3 multi-tenant data leaks, 151 `as any` casts, dead code in items.ts |
| Performance | 5/10 | KPI ignores company_id, 20-call GL waterfall, no pagination on core lists |
| Security | 5/10 | Committed credentials, broken portal session, no rate limiting, passwords logged |
| Developer Experience | 5.5/10 | No CI/CD, broken E2E config, 45+ services with zero test coverage |
| Dependencies & Infra | 4/10 | Committed DB password, migration runner broken, unencrypted origin traffic |

---

## Quick Wins (< 30 min each)

- [ ] Add `company_id` filter to products, assets, stock-adjustments, run-depreciation queries
- [ ] Add `_companyId` usage to all kpiService queries (replace underscore prefix)
- [ ] Exclude `password` field from api-error-handler body logging
- [ ] Add migrations 245-248 to the runner array
- [ ] Add `/payroll/:path*` to middleware matcher
- [ ] Rotate Neon DB credentials and JWT secret
- [ ] Install `@vitest/coverage-v8`
- [ ] Fix Playwright config: update package.json to use `--config playwright-test.config.ts`
- [ ] Add `Strict-Transport-Security` header to next.config.js

## Recommended Roadmap

### Week 1: Security & Data Isolation (Critical)
1. Fix all 6 multi-tenant data leak modules
2. Fix portal auth (set signed httpOnly cookie)
3. Rotate committed credentials
4. Add rate limiting to auth endpoints
5. Stop logging passwords
6. Add CSP + HSTS headers

### Week 2-3: Infrastructure & Quality
7. Fix migration runner (tracking table + add missing files)
8. Set up GitHub Actions CI (lint, type-check, unit tests)
9. Fix Playwright E2E config
10. Add pagination to customers/suppliers/assets APIs
11. Split monolith files (dashboard, bank recon service)
12. Lazy-load recharts on dashboard

### Week 4+: Ongoing
13. Write unit tests for payroll tax calculations
14. Write unit tests for bank reconciliation
15. Standardize API route patterns
16. Add Zod validation to mutation routes
17. Implement refresh-token flow
18. Switch Cloudflare to Full (Strict) SSL

function mapPayrollRun(row: Row): PayrollRun {
  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    period_start: String(row.period_start),
    period_end: String(row.period_end),
    run_date: String(row.run_date),
    status: String(row.status) as PayrollRun['status'],
    total_gross: Number(row.total_gross) || 0,
    total_paye: Number(row.total_paye) || 0,
    total_uif_employee: Number(row.total_uif_employee) || 0,
    total_uif_employer: Number(row.total_uif_employer) || 0,
    total_sdl: Number(row.total_sdl) || 0,
    total_net: Number(row.total_net) || 0,
    total_company_cost: Number(row.total_company_cost) || 0,
    journal_entry_id: row.journal_entry_id ? String(row.journal_entry_id) : null,
    created_by: row.created_by ? String(row.created_by) : null,
    created_at: String(row.created_at),
  };
}

function mapPayslip(row: Row): Payslip {
  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    payroll_run_id: String(row.payroll_run_id),
    employee_id: String(row.employee_id),
    basic_salary: Number(row.basic_salary) || 0,
    travel_allowance: Number(row.travel_allowance) || 0,
    housing_allowance: Number(row.housing_allowance) || 0,
    cell_allowance: Number(row.cell_allowance) || 0,
    other_allowances: Number(row.other_allowances) || 0,
    gross_pay: Number(row.gross_pay) || 0,
    paye: Number(row.paye) || 0,
    uif_employee: Number(row.uif_employee) || 0,
    uif_employer: Number(row.uif_employer) || 0,
    sdl: Number(row.sdl) || 0,
    medical_aid: Number(row.medical_aid) || 0,
    retirement_fund: Number(row.retirement_fund) || 0,
    other_deductions: Number(row.other_deductions) || 0,
    total_deductions: Number(row.total_deductions) || 0,
    net_pay: Number(row.net_pay) || 0,
    ytd_gross: Number(row.ytd_gross) || 0,
    ytd_paye: Number(row.ytd_paye) || 0,
    ytd_uif: Number(row.ytd_uif) || 0,
    created_at: String(row.created_at),
  };
}
